items.original: Fixed Grep and Glob not applying `Read(...)` deny rules to files reached through a symlinked search path

title.zh-TW: Workflow 先查權限，再讀取 scriptPath
title.en: Workflow checks permission before reading scriptPath

body.zh-TW: Workflow 工具遇到 `scriptPath` 時，現在先確認該工作階段能不能讀，再碰檔案內容。`scriptPath` 是工作流程腳本所在的位置。以前權限檢查尚未執行，工具就可能先讀取範圍外腳本，甚至把內容引用進錯誤訊息；即使最後拒絕，資料也已先被碰到。⟦倉庫揀貨員現在先核對揀貨單上的儲位是否屬於可取範圍，再打開箱子；不會先拆開未核准區的箱子，還把標籤內容抄進退件單後才問能不能拿。⟧
body.en: When Workflow receives a `scriptPath`, it now checks whether the session may read that location before touching the file. A `scriptPath` identifies where a workflow script lives. Previously, the tool could read an out-of-scope script and even quote it in an error before the permission check ran. A later denial came too late to prevent that read. ⟦The warehouse picker now verifies that a bin is on the approved picking sheet before opening its box. The worker no longer opens a box in an unapproved section and copies its label into a rejection slip before asking.⟧

items.original: Fixed the Workflow tool reading (and quoting in errors) a `scriptPath` outside what the session may read before the permission check ran

title.zh-TW: 外掛指令不能再指向外掛目錄之外
title.en: Marketplace plugin commands stay inside their plugin

body.zh-TW: 從市集項目安裝外掛（擴充 Claude 功能的附加元件）時，裡面宣告的指令現在只能指向自己的外掛目錄。以前那條路徑可以繞到目錄外，讓看似屬於外掛的指令實際執行別處內容。現在會直接回報 path-traversal error（用路徑寫法繞出允許資料夾的錯誤）並拒絕。⟦倉庫揀貨單上的外掛專區儲位，只能對應該專區內的貨架。若編號寫法一路繞到別區，系統會把它當成越區路徑錯誤，不會照單取貨。⟧
body.en: A command declared by a marketplace plugin must now point inside that plugin's own directory. A plugin is an add-on that extends Claude. Previously, its path could travel outside the directory, so a command presented as part of the plugin could execute content elsewhere. Such a path is now rejected with a path-traversal error, meaning the path notation tried to escape its allowed folder. ⟦On the warehouse picking sheet, a bin in the plugin section may refer only to shelves within that section. If its written route winds into another area, the warehouse flags the route and does not pick the item.⟧

items.original: Fixed plugin commands declared in a marketplace entry being able to point outside the plugin directory; such paths are now rejected with a path-traversal error

title.zh-TW: 專案不能私開詳細追蹤，也不能改送遙測資料
title.en: Projects cannot enable deep tracing or reroute telemetry

body.zh-TW: ⟦檢體只能送到總部指定的實驗室；分院不能自行多抄一份完整檢體紀錄，也不能把低層送件處改接另一間實驗室。指定來源無論是總部規章或主院系統，都要照辦。⟧專案設定不再能開啟詳細 beta tracing 或記錄原始 API body。beta tracing 是測試中的追蹤資料功能，API body 則是送往服務的原始內容。較低範圍的 beta tracing endpoint（追蹤資料送達的網址）也不能繞過受管設定或主機應用程式指定的 OTLP collector。OTLP collector 是集中接收遙測資料的服務。
body.en: ⟦Samples must go to the laboratory selected by headquarters. A branch cannot copy the complete raw record or redirect a lower-level drop-off desk to another lab, whether the destination was fixed by policy or by the host facility.⟧ Project settings can no longer enable detailed beta tracing or raw API-body logging. Beta tracing is an experimental way to record diagnostic activity; an API body is the original content sent to a service. A lower-scope beta tracing endpoint also cannot bypass an OTLP collector pinned by managed settings or the host app. An OTLP collector centrally receives telemetry data.

items.original: Fixed project settings being able to enable detailed beta tracing or raw API body logging, and a lower-scope beta tracing endpoint bypassing an OTLP collector pinned by managed settings or a host app

title.zh-TW: 改動沙盒核心防護前，受管設定也要先核可
title.en: Managed sandbox changes now require approval

body.zh-TW: 伺服器送來的受管設定若會終止沙盒 TLS、改走自帶代理、注入憑證，或削弱沙盒隔離，現在套用前都要你核可。沙盒（把程式限制在隔離範圍內執行）不再因設定由伺服器管理，就默默接受這類關鍵變更。終止沙盒 TLS 指的是把加密連線在中途拆開查看，注入憑證則是替請求自動帶上登入用的密鑰。⟦租約即使由房東統一管理，只要改到轉接線路、代收鑰匙或縮小隔離空間，也得讓承租人重新看過並簽名，不能直接生效。⟧
body.en: Server-managed settings that terminate sandbox TLS, route sandbox traffic through a custom proxy, inject credentials, or weaken sandbox isolation now require approval before applying. A sandbox confines program execution to a restricted area. Server ownership no longer makes these sensitive changes silent. Terminating sandbox TLS means unwrapping the encrypted connection partway; injecting credentials means attaching sign-in secrets to requests automatically. ⟦Even when a landlord manages the lease, changes to wiring, stored keys, or the size of the isolated space must be shown to the tenant and signed again before taking effect.⟧

items.original: Changed server-managed settings that terminate sandbox TLS, route sandbox traffic through your own proxy, inject credentials, or weaken sandbox isolation to require approval before they apply

title.zh-TW: 敏感自訂標頭套用前要先核可
title.en: Sensitive custom headers require approval

body.zh-TW: 受管或專案設定裡的 `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`，若加入憑證、組織或租戶、路由、API 行為相關標頭，現在會先要求核可。標頭（跟著 API 請求傳送的附加欄位）包含原文點名的 `Authorization` 與 `Host`。可直接放進設定檔的完整 JSON 示範如下；`Bearer example` 只是範例值：`{"env": {"ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS": "Authorization: Bearer example"}}`。⟦租約增列代領鑰匙、承租單位、款項轉送或房屋使用方式時，不能夾在附件裡自動生效，必須重新簽名。⟧
body.en: When `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` in managed or project settings adds credential, organization or tenant, routing, or API-behavior headers, approval is now required. A header is an extra field sent with an API request. The named examples include `Authorization` and `Host`. This complete JSON can be placed in a settings file; `Bearer example` is only a sample value: `{"env": {"ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS": "Authorization: Bearer example"}}`. ⟦A lease addendum about stored keys, the tenant organization, payment routing, or permitted use cannot quietly take effect as an attachment. It must be signed again.⟧

items.original: Changed `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` from managed or project settings to require approval when it sets a credential, org/tenant, routing, or API-behavior header (e.g. `Authorization`, `Host`)

title.zh-TW: 設定沒變就不重問，對話框只列新變動
title.en: Approval dialogs show only changed managed settings

body.zh-TW: 受管設定需要你核可時，對話框現在只列出自上次核可後改過的項目，不再把已看過且未變的設定整份重貼。重新登入同一個 Claude apps gateway，只要設定內容沒變，也不會再次跳出核可提示。⟦租約修訂時，房東只圈出上次簽名後新增或改動的條款；你重新走進同一間辦公室，而租約一字未改，就不用把整份文件再簽一次。簽名仍針對真正的變更。⟧
body.en: When managed settings need approval, the dialog now lists only what changed since your last approval. It no longer repeats the full set of settings you already reviewed and that remain unchanged. Signing in again to the same Claude apps gateway also does not reopen the prompt if its settings are identical. ⟦When a lease is revised, the landlord circles only clauses added or changed since the last signature. Returning to the same office with an unchanged lease does not require signing the whole document again; signatures still cover real changes.⟧

items.original:
Improved the managed settings approval dialog to list only the settings that changed since you last approved them
Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt re-appearing after signing in again to the same Claude apps gateway when the settings are unchanged

title.zh-TW: 專案 env 不再能改 Claude 設定與暫存目錄
title.en: Project env can no longer relocate config or temp directories

body.zh-TW: 專案層 `.claude/settings.json` 的 `env`，不再接受 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`、`CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`、`TMPDIR`、`TMP` 或 `TEMP`。這些目錄要改到 shell、使用者或受管設定中，避免專案自己搬動個人設定與暫存位置。以下是使用者或受管設定可貼的完整 JSON；路徑都只是範例值：`{"env": {"CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR": "/example/config", "CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR": "/example/claude-tmp", "TMPDIR": "/example/tmp", "TMP": "/example/tmp", "TEMP": "/example/tmp"}}`。⟦公司的置物櫃位置由員工本人或總務決定，各部門不能在自己的手冊裡把櫃子搬去別處。⟧
body.en: The `env` block in project-level `.claude/settings.json` can no longer set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`, `TMPDIR`, `TMP`, or `TEMP`. Put these directory choices in the shell, user settings, or managed settings instead, so a project cannot relocate personal configuration or temporary storage. This complete JSON is suitable for user or managed settings; every path is only an example value: `{"env": {"CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR": "/example/config", "CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR": "/example/claude-tmp", "TMPDIR": "/example/tmp", "TMP": "/example/tmp", "TEMP": "/example/tmp"}}`. ⟦An employee or central facilities team chooses the location of a company locker. Individual departments cannot move that locker by writing a different location in their own manuals.⟧

items.original: Changed project-level `.claude/settings.json` `env` to no longer set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR`, or `TMPDIR`/`TMP`/`TEMP`; set them in your shell, user, or managed settings instead

title.zh-TW: 背景工作檯可編輯，市集重整也不丟外掛技能
title.en: Background worktrees stay editable and retain plugin skills

body.zh-TW: 背景工作階段或它的子代理，用 `git worktree add` 自己建立工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的 Git 功能）後，現在能在裡面改檔，不會被自己建的工作區擋住。另一個 Claude Code 程序若剛好同時重整外掛市集，背景工作階段也不會偶爾以完全沒有外掛技能的狀態啟動，並一直缺到結束。⟦夜班同事接手自己搭好的工作檯時，工具與材料都能正常使用；就算白班正在重整工具目錄，也不會讓夜班整晚拿不到任何專用工具。⟧
body.en: A background session or its subagents can now edit files inside a worktree they created with `git worktree add`. A worktree is Git's way to open parallel working copies of one project. Separately, if another Claude Code process refreshes the plugin marketplace at the same moment, a background session no longer starts with no plugin skills and stays that way. ⟦A night-shift coworker can use the bench they assembled, with its tools and materials intact. Even while the day shift reorganizes the tool catalog, the night worker does not lose every specialized tool for the whole shift.⟧

items.original:
Fixed background sessions and their subagents being unable to edit files inside a git worktree they created with `git worktree add`
Fixed background sessions occasionally starting without any plugin skills (and staying that way) when another Claude Code process was refreshing the plugin marketplace at the same moment

title.zh-TW: SSH 裡複製文字與終端編輯器按鍵都恢復正常
title.en: Remote tmux copying and TTY editor controls work again

body.zh-TW: 你透過 SSH 在 tmux 裡打開背景工作階段並選取文字時，現在會像前台工作階段一樣複製到 tmux 緩衝區，不再退回 OSC 52。tmux 緩衝區（終端多工工具自己保存複製文字的地方）因此能收到內容。`emacs -nw`、`micro` 等會開 `/dev/tty` 的編輯器，也不再讓背景工作階段中的 Ctrl+G 失敗並顯示 `Emacs quit unexpectedly`。⟦夜班同事接手工作檯後，剪下的便條會放進桌上同一個收納盤，編輯器的操作鍵也接回正確線路，按 Ctrl+G 不再報錯。⟧
body.en: When you open a background session in tmux over SSH and select text, it now copies to the tmux buffer just as a foreground session does instead of falling back to OSC 52. The tmux buffer is the terminal multiplexer's own place for copied text. Editors that open `/dev/tty`, including `emacs -nw` and `micro`, also no longer make Ctrl+G fail with `Emacs quit unexpectedly` in background sessions. ⟦At the night-shift bench, clipped notes now land in the same desk tray, and the editor's control key is reconnected correctly. Pressing Ctrl+G no longer reports an error.⟧

items.original:
Fixed selecting text in an opened background session inside tmux over SSH: it now copies to the tmux buffer like a foreground session instead of falling back to OSC 52
Fixed Ctrl+G failing with "Emacs quit unexpectedly" in background sessions for editors that open `/dev/tty`, such as `emacs -nw` and `micro`

title.zh-TW: 背景工作不再丟 gateway 環境，也不誤問額度
title.en: Background sessions keep gateway settings and valid allowance

body.zh-TW: 把互動工作階段用 `←`、`/background` 或 `--bg` 轉到背景後，shell 匯出的 Vertex 或 Bedrock gateway 環境變數（程式啟動前從 shell 帶入的設定）不再遺失。相關變數包含 `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` 與 `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`；以前一丟失，每個請求都會失敗。Max 方案執行 `claude --bg --model fable` 時，若同帳戶的互動工作階段仍有 Fable allowance，也不再停下索取 usage credits。⟦夜班同事接手工作檯時，會連同接線圖與可用材料額度一起接走，不會因換班拔掉 gateway 線路，也不會明明材料還能用卻叫你再補貨。⟧
body.en: After an interactive session moves to the background with `←`, `/background`, or `--bg`, it now keeps Vertex or Bedrock gateway environment variables exported by the shell. Environment variables are settings supplied by the shell before a program starts. These include `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` and `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`; losing them previously made every request fail. On Max plans, `claude --bg --model fable` also no longer stops for usage credits while the interactive session on the same account still has Fable allowance. ⟦The night-shift coworker inherits both the bench wiring and its available materials. A shift change no longer unplugs the gateway or asks for more supplies while usable stock remains.⟧

items.original:
Fixed backgrounded sessions (`←`, `/background`, `--bg`) losing a Vertex/Bedrock gateway (`ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` + `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`) exported in the shell, so every request failed
Fixed `claude --bg --model fable` on Max plans stopping to ask for usage credits while the interactive session on the same account still had Fable allowance

title.zh-TW: 輸入送出後才顯示建議，無人工作也不跳詢問
title.en: Suggestions wait for typing, and unattended sessions stay quiet

body.zh-TW: 你正在輸入時，外掛或 LSP 安裝建議，以及「把 auto mode 設成預設」的詢問，現在會等到文字已送出或清空才出現。LSP（讓編輯器理解程式碼的語言服務）提示不會再搶在送出鍵旁邊，避免送提示的 Enter 順手回答彈出的問題。沒有使用者看顧的工作階段，例如 agent-team 隊友窗格，也不再顯示那則一次性 auto mode 詢問，避免游離按鍵在沒人讀過時接受它。⟦超市收銀機先等商品掃完、購物籃清空，才彈出集點問卷；沒有人站在櫃台前時，問卷也不會自行跳出等著誤觸。⟧
body.en: While you are typing, plugin or LSP installation suggestions and the offer to make auto mode the default now wait until the input is sent or cleared. LSP is a language service that helps an editor understand code. The Enter key used to send your prompt can no longer answer a newly appeared suggestion by accident. Unattended sessions, such as agent-team teammate panes, also no longer show the one-time auto-mode offer, where a stray keypress could accept it unread. ⟦A supermarket register waits until every item is scanned and the basket is cleared before showing its loyalty survey. With nobody at the checkout, the survey does not pop up and wait for an accidental tap.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the one-time "make auto mode your default" offer appearing in unattended sessions (e.g. agent-team teammate panes), where a stray keypress could accept it unread
Changed plugin/LSP install suggestions and the auto-mode default offer to wait until you've sent or cleared what you're typing, so the Enter that sends your prompt can't answer them

title.zh-TW: 全新安裝照帳號預設啟動，受管開關可中途退回
title.en: Fresh installs honor auto mode, and policy can switch it off mid-session

body.zh-TW: ⟦家電第一次開箱會照帳號選好的預設模式啟動；使用途中若公司的總開關改成禁止自動運轉，機器就回到一般模式，不會繼續沿用舊狀態。⟧全新安裝第一次啟動時，帳號的啟動預設若是 auto mode（Claude 不逐項詢問就自行執行的模式），現在就會直接進 auto mode，不再錯進 default mode。工作階段已在 auto mode 運作時，若中途收到受管設定 `disableAutoMode`，也會立刻退回 default mode，不必重開工作階段才生效。
body.en: ⟦A newly unboxed appliance starts in the mode selected by its account. If a company-wide switch later forbids automatic operation, the appliance returns to its ordinary mode instead of continuing with stale behavior.⟧ On the first launch after a fresh install, an account whose startup default is auto mode now actually starts there rather than in default mode. Auto mode lets Claude act without asking about each step. If managed setting `disableAutoMode` arrives while a session is already in auto mode, that running session moves back to default mode without needing a restart.

items.original:
Fixed the first launch on a fresh install starting in default mode instead of auto mode for accounts whose startup default is auto mode
Fixed managed-settings `disableAutoMode` arriving mid-session not moving an already-running auto-mode session back to default mode

title.zh-TW: 關閉思考時自動降 effort，各模型各記預設
title.en: Effort falls back safely and remembers each model

body.zh-TW: Opus 5 在 thinking 關閉時若收到 xhigh 或 max effort，過去會以 `effort … is not supported when thinking is disabled` 失敗；現在這種請求改送 `high`。effort（模型願意投入多少推理工作的等級）因此不會因組合不支援而卡住。`/effort` 也改成每個模型各存自己的預設值，切換模型再切回來時，會找回該模型原本的設定。⟦健身器材各自記住自己的配重；某台器材停用高強度功能時，過重檔位會降到可用的 high，而不是整台拒絕啟動。⟧
body.en: When thinking is disabled, Opus 5 requests with xhigh or max effort used to fail with `effort … is not supported when thinking is disabled`. They now send `high` instead. Effort is the level of reasoning work assigned to the model, so this unsupported combination no longer stops the request. `/effort` also saves a separate default for each model and restores that model's own setting when you switch back. ⟦Each gym machine remembers its own weight. If one machine disables its highest-intensity feature, an excessive setting drops to the supported high position instead of preventing the machine from starting.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Opus 5 requests failing with "effort … is not supported when thinking is disabled" when effort was xhigh/max and thinking was turned off; effort is now sent as `high` in that case
Changed `/effort` to save your default effort level per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch

title.zh-TW: 純思考回合不卡住，壞掉的工具輸出會先移除
title.en: Thinking-only turns recover, and malformed tool output is discarded

body.zh-TW: 模型某回合只產生 thinking、沒有文字內容時，對話不再卡在 `text content blocks must be non-empty`。thinking（模型在回答前處理問題的推理內容）本身不會因缺少文字區塊讓後續停住。若模型產生格式錯誤的工具呼叫，重試前也會把那份壞掉輸出從脈絡中移除，避免帶著同一份錯誤再試；這項修正涵蓋 Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry。⟦影印機遇到卡紙，會先抽掉皺掉的那張再重印；若只是機器先在內部整理頁面、還沒吐出紙，也不會誤報空白紙張錯誤而鎖死。⟧
body.en: If a model turn produces only thinking and no text, the conversation no longer gets stuck on `text content blocks must be non-empty`. Thinking is the model's reasoning work before an answer, and its absence of a text block no longer blocks what follows. If a tool call is malformed, retry now removes the broken output from context rather than retrying with the same bad material. This applies on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry. ⟦A copier clears the crumpled sheet before printing again. If it is merely arranging pages internally and has not emitted a sheet yet, it does not mistake that pause for an empty-page fault and lock itself.⟧

items.original:
Fixed conversations getting stuck on "text content blocks must be non-empty" errors after a turn where the model produced only thinking
Improved retry when the model's tool call is malformed: the broken output is now dropped from the retry context, including on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry

title.zh-TW: 隊友答案送到領隊，背景子代理也能回傳訊息
title.en: Agent-team answers and replies reach the right teammate

body.zh-TW: ⟦接力賽的最後一棒現在會把接力棒交到領隊手上，而不是只喊一聲「我有空了」；跑者即使只知道來訊者是同隊手足或上層，也能沿原路把回覆交回去。⟧代理團隊中，隊友的最終答案現在放進閒置通知送達 team lead，不再只送一則沒有內容的 `available` 通知。背景子代理收到未具名手足或上層代理的訊息時，也能正常回覆；以前 `from` 放的是代理類型，不是可投遞的位址，因此回信失敗。
body.en: ⟦The final relay runner now puts the baton in the team lead's hand instead of merely shouting that they are available. Even when the sender is identified only as a sibling or parent on the same team, the runner can return a reply along the incoming route.⟧ A teammate's final answer now reaches the team lead in the idle notification rather than being replaced by an empty `available` notice. Background subagents can also reply to messages from unnamed sibling or parent agents. Previously, `from` held an agent type rather than a deliverable address.

items.original:
Fixed agent teams: a teammate's final answer not reaching the team lead — it now arrives in the idle notification instead of a content-free "available" notice
Fixed background subagents being unable to reply to a message from an unnamed sibling or parent agent (`from` was the agent type, which is not an address)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息走 Desktop，寄件者與回覆對象更清楚
title.en: Desktop relays cross-session messages with clearer senders

body.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 從另一個工作階段送來訊息後，回覆該工作階段 ID 的 `SendMessage` 現在會經 Claude Desktop 送達，不再回報 `not reachable`。Claude 也會被明確告知，寄件者是本工作階段內的 worker（替目前工作分工的子代理），不是無關的 Claude 工作階段。查看背景子代理或分叉逐字稿時，輸入框提示會顯示 `Message @name…`；這些逐字稿可從子代理面板或 `/tasks` 開啟。⟦接力賽不只把棒送回正確跑道，棒上的標籤還寫明是本隊哪位跑者；站在分段紀錄前時，交棒區也直接顯示下一棒的名字。⟧
body.en: After Claude Desktop delivers a message from another session, `SendMessage` replies to that session ID now travel back through Claude Desktop instead of failing with `not reachable`. Claude is also told that the sender is a worker inside the current session, meaning a subagent assigned part of this work, not an unrelated Claude session. While viewing a background-subagent or fork transcript opened from the subagent panel or `/tasks`, the input placeholder now reads `Message @name…`. ⟦The relay not only returns the baton to the correct lane; its label names the runner from this team. At a split transcript, the exchange zone also displays the next runner's name.⟧

items.original:
Fixed replying to a message Claude Desktop delivered from another session: `SendMessage` to that session id now delivers through Claude Desktop instead of failing with "not reachable"
Improved framing of messages from your own subagents: Claude is told the sender is a worker inside this session, not an unrelated Claude session
Improved the prompt placeholder to read "Message @name…" while viewing a background subagent or fork transcript opened from the subagent panel or `/tasks`

title.zh-TW: 平行子代理進度不再堆滿畫面，互動時也少重繪
title.en: Parallel-agent progress stops piling up and wasting redraws

body.zh-TW: 大量平行子代理同時工作時，每秒更新的進度訊息現在會覆蓋前一則，不再一行行堆進逐字稿，造成 TUI 卡頓。TUI（在終端機裡操作的文字介面）因此只保留眼前最新進度。互動工作階段在處理回合期間，也砍掉了多餘的 UI 重繪，降低 CPU 使用。兩項調整都沒有少報工作結果，只是避免把沒有必要保留的畫面反覆畫出。⟦白板上的進度改成擦掉舊數字再重寫，而不是每次都往上貼一張便利貼；寫字的人也不會在內容沒變時重描整面白板。⟧
body.en: With many parallel subagents, each per-second progress tick now replaces its predecessor instead of adding another transcript line and making the TUI lag. A TUI is a text interface operated inside the terminal, and it now keeps only the latest progress view. Interactive sessions also cut redundant UI redraws during turns, reducing CPU use. Neither change hides final work; both avoid repainting transient information that need not remain. ⟦Progress on a whiteboard is updated by erasing the old number and writing the new one, not by adding another sticky note each time. The writer also stops redrawing the whole board when its contents have not changed.⟧

items.original:
Fixed TUI lag with many parallel subagents: per-second progress ticks now replace their predecessor instead of piling up in the transcript
Improved CPU usage during turns in interactive sessions by cutting redundant UI re-renders

title.zh-TW: screen 與 tmux 的斜體不再變成反白色塊
title.en: Italics stop turning into highlighted blocks in screen and tmux

body.zh-TW: ⟦投影機若把斜體字誤認成一整塊底色，原本只是輕輕傾斜的提示就會搶走整個畫面。現在投影規則辨認正確，斜體仍是斜體。⟧在 GNU screen 與終端機類型設為 `screen` 的 tmux 工作階段裡，Claude Code 先前會把斜體文字畫成反白方塊，例如工作階段回顧那一行。這是既有顯示的修正；文字內容沒變，但重點不會再被錯誤色塊淹沒，在終端機裡也較容易讀出層次。
body.en: ⟦Imagine a projector mistaking italic type for a solid block of color: a gentle emphasis suddenly takes over the whole screen. The display rule now recognizes the type correctly, so italics stay italic.⟧ In GNU screen and tmux sessions whose terminal type is `screen`, Claude Code used to render italic text as highlighted blocks, including the session recap line. This fixes the existing display without changing the text itself, so the intended visual hierarchy remains readable in the terminal.

items.original: Fixed italic text (such as the session recap line) rendering as highlighted blocks in GNU screen and in tmux sessions using a `screen` terminal type

title.zh-TW: MCP 說明與伺服器名稱各自回到正確位置
title.en: MCP instructions and server names now say exactly what they should

body.zh-TW: 管理 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，畫面上的字現在更可信。選單的複製快捷鍵會說清楚登入網址如何被複製，不再一律宣稱成功；`claude mcp add --header` 與 `claude mcp add-json` 的說明也改成正確的傳輸方式。錯誤訊息、選單和指令結果裡的 MCP 伺服器名稱還會先淨化再顯示，避免名稱帶進不該呈現的內容。⟦五金行把零件抽屜重新貼標籤：標籤既要寫對拿取方法，也要把沾污的字清乾淨，顧客才不會照錯格子找。⟧
body.en: Text shown while managing MCP (Model Context Protocol, the standard that connects AI to external tools) is now more trustworthy. The menu's copy shortcut explains how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success, while `claude mcp add --header` and `claude mcp add-json` now name the correct transports. MCP server names are also sanitized before appearing in errors, menus, and command results, keeping unwanted content out of those surfaces. ⟦A hardware shop has relabeled its parts drawers: each label must describe the right pickup method and have any smudged text cleaned away, or customers will search the wrong bin.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the MCP server menu's copy shortcut: it now says how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success
Fixed `claude mcp add --header` and `claude mcp add-json` help text naming the wrong transports
Improved sanitization of MCP server names in error messages, menus, and command results

title.zh-TW: 壞掉的 additionalDirectories 項目會被跳過
title.en: Broken additionalDirectories entries are skipped instead of stopping startup

body.zh-TW: ⟦條碼掃描機遇到一張破損標籤時，應把那件貨先放旁邊，而不是讓整條輸送帶停住。現在 Claude Code 也會跳過壞項目，繼續處理其餘資料。⟧`additionalDirectories` 是額外允許使用的資料夾清單；若其中一項含空位元組（字串裡不能當一般文字處理的空字元），過去可能讓程式啟動崩潰。若內容來自 SDK 主機、IDE 或掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），還可能連帶弄壞 `/add-dir` 與之後的設定更新。現在只略過那一項，不再讓單筆壞資料拖垮後續操作。
body.en: ⟦When a barcode scanner meets one damaged label, it should set that parcel aside rather than stop the entire conveyor. Claude Code now skips the bad entry and continues with the rest.⟧ `additionalDirectories` is the list of extra folders a session may use. An entry containing a null byte (a non-text marker that does not belong inside a normal path) could previously crash startup. If it came from an SDK host, IDE, or hook (a small program triggered by an event), it could also break `/add-dir` and later settings updates. Only that malformed entry is now ignored, so one bad value no longer derails the following operations.

items.original: Fixed an `additionalDirectories` entry containing a null byte crashing startup, or breaking `/add-dir` and later settings updates when it came from an SDK host, IDE, or hook; it is now skipped

title.zh-TW: 切換目錄不再覆蓋同 ID 的逐字稿
title.en: Changing directories no longer overwrites a transcript with the same ID

body.zh-TW: 你在工作階段中變更目錄後，逐字稿（保存整段對話內容的紀錄檔）也可能跟著搬到另一個位置。以前若目的地已經有一份相同工作階段 ID 的逐字稿，新搬來的內容會無聲蓋掉舊檔；你既看不到警告，也可能直到回頭找對話才發現少了一份。現在這種碰撞不再造成覆蓋。⟦相機記憶卡已有同檔名照片時，不能把新照片直接寫上去還假裝沒事；先保住原片，兩段紀錄才不會只剩後來那份。⟧這修的是改目錄時的保存風險，不是新增另一套逐字稿功能。
body.en: Changing directories during a session can relocate its transcript (the file that preserves the conversation). If the destination already held a transcript with the same session ID, the incoming one used to overwrite it silently. There was no warning, and the loss might remain hidden until you searched for the older conversation. That collision no longer overwrites the existing record. ⟦A camera must not write a new photo over an image with the same filename and pretend nothing happened. Preserving the original keeps two memories from collapsing into only the newer one.⟧ This fixes a storage risk during directory changes; it does not introduce a separate transcript system.

items.original: Fixed session transcripts being silently overwritten when a directory change relocated a session onto an existing same-ID transcript

title.zh-TW: stream-json 工具呼叫不再被併掉結果
title.en: stream-json tool calls no longer lose results when IDs are missing

body.zh-TW: ⟦洗衣店收到幾張沒寫取件單號的單據，不能把它們全釘在第一張下面，否則後面的衣物交回來也找不到各自紀錄。現在每筆工具呼叫都能保住自己的結果。⟧使用 `--input-format stream-json` 時，用戶端可注入助理的工具呼叫。這些呼叫若沒有訊息 ID，過去會被併進第一則呼叫，回來的工具結果因而遺失；續接較舊的工作階段也會發生。修正後，缺少訊息 ID 不再讓後續呼叫與結果被第一則吞掉，串流整合可以維持原本的對應關係。
body.en: ⟦A laundry shop cannot staple every claim ticket without a number under the first ticket; when the clothes return, their individual records would be impossible to match. Each tool call can now keep its own result.⟧ With `--input-format stream-json`, a client can inject assistant tool calls. Calls without a message ID used to be merged into the first call, causing their tool results to disappear. The same failure could occur while resuming older sessions. Missing IDs no longer let later calls and results get swallowed by the first one, preserving the intended mapping in streaming integrations.

items.original: Fixed `--input-format stream-json`: client-injected assistant tool calls sent without a message id were merged into the first one and their results lost, including when resuming older sessions

title.zh-TW: MCP 握手有逾時，重連提示也給真正解法
title.en: MCP handshakes time out cleanly and reconnect shows the real remedy

body.zh-TW: SDK 或雲端工作階段連接 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，要先等對方回覆握手確認。若確認遺失，過去整個工作階段可能無限等候；現在等 70 秒便逾時，而且只把沒回應的那台伺服器標為失敗，不會假裝有備援或改派。Remote Control 裡執行 `/mcp reconnect` 時，若伺服器在另一個工作階段被停用，畫面也會顯示真正的處理方式，不再只丟出隱去細節的籠統錯誤。⟦電話響了 70 秒仍沒人接，就掛斷並記下這支不通；其他電話照常保留，記事本也寫明該找誰恢復。⟧
body.en: SDK and cloud sessions wait for an acknowledgment while connecting to an MCP server. MCP is the protocol that connects AI to external tools. If that acknowledgment was lost, the whole session could wait forever; it now times out after 70 seconds and marks only the unresponsive server as failed, without inventing a fallback or rerouting the work. In Remote Control, `/mcp reconnect` also shows the actual remedy when another session disabled that server instead of hiding it behind a generic error. ⟦If a phone rings for 70 seconds with no answer, hang up and note that this line failed. Keep the other calls intact, and write down how to restore the unavailable line.⟧

items.original:
Fixed SDK and cloud sessions hanging indefinitely when an SDK MCP server's handshake acknowledgment was lost; the wait now times out after 70 seconds and marks only that server failed
Fixed `/mcp reconnect` on Remote Control showing a generic withheld-detail error instead of the real remedy when a server was disabled in another session

title.zh-TW: 強制停止工作階段後，Bash 程序也會停下
title.en: Force-stopping a session now stops its Bash processes too

body.zh-TW: ⟦工廠下班不能只關辦公室的燈，產線機台卻繼續空轉；按下總停止後，底下仍在跑的機台也得一起斷電。⟧在自架 runner（由自己管理、負責執行工作的機器）上，卡住的 Claude Code 工作階段可能需要被強制停止。過去畫面上的工作階段雖然結束，它啟動的 Bash 工具程序仍可能留在背景執行，繼續占用機器或動到工作內容。修正後，強制停止卡住的工作階段也會清掉這些 Bash 程序，結束狀態不再只停在外層。
body.en: ⟦At closing time, a factory cannot switch off only the office lights while production machines keep idling. Hitting the main stop must cut power to the machines still running underneath.⟧ On a self-hosted runner (a machine you operate to execute jobs), a stuck Claude Code session may need to be force-stopped. Previously the session could disappear while Bash tool processes it started kept running in the background, still consuming the machine or touching the work. The fix terminates those Bash processes with the stuck session, so the stopped state now reaches the work underneath.

items.original: Fixed self-hosted runner leaving a stuck session's Bash tool processes running after the session was force-stopped

title.zh-TW: 沙盒裡的 Bash 輸出檔不再能被替換
title.en: Sandboxed Bash output files can no longer be redirected or replaced

body.zh-TW: Bash 指令在沙盒（限制程式能碰哪些資源的隔離環境）中執行時，Claude Code 會建立輸出檔，再把內容讀回來呈現。這次改了輸出檔的建立與讀回方式：沙盒中的指令不能再把輸出重導到別處，也不能在讀回前用另一個檔案取代它。這是既有隔離機制的補強，重點不是改變你看到的 Bash 輸出，而是確保畫面讀到的確實是那次指令留下的內容。⟦印刷廠的打樣稿從印出到交件都由同一套流程保管，中途不能把別張紙塞進封套；你最後核對的才會是原來那份稿。⟧
body.en: When Bash runs in a sandbox (an isolated environment that limits what a program can touch), Claude Code creates an output file and reads it back for display. The creation and readback path has changed: a sandboxed command can no longer redirect that output elsewhere or replace the file before Claude Code reads it. This strengthens the existing isolation. It does not change the intended Bash output; it makes sure the displayed content truly came from that command. ⟦A print shop keeps a proof under one controlled process from printing to delivery, so nobody can slip a different sheet into the sleeve halfway through. The copy you approve is therefore the proof that was actually produced.⟧

items.original: Changed how Bash command output files are created and read back when commands run in the sandbox, so a sandboxed command cannot redirect or replace them

title.zh-TW: 整數變數的算術指派不再自動獲准
title.en: Arithmetic assignments to integer shell variables now require approval

body.zh-TW: ⟦郵局磅秤若看到特定包裝就自動當成免郵資，根本沒真正秤過內容；現在這類包裹會停下來請人確認，不再憑外觀放行。⟧Bash 權限檢查（執行指令前判斷是否需要你同意的步驟）先前會自動核准一類指令：把算術式指定給整數 shell 變數，例如 `OPTIND` 或 `RANDOM`。問題在於，算術式本身仍可能帶來不該略過的行為，不能只因為外層看起來是變數指派就視為安全。現在這類指令會顯示核可提示，讓你先看過再決定是否執行；這是收緊既有判斷，不是禁止所有整數變數指派。
body.en: ⟦If a post-office scale treated certain wrapping as proof of free postage, it would never weigh what was inside. Those parcels now stop for a person to check instead of passing on appearance alone.⟧ Bash permission checks (the step that decides whether a command needs your consent) used to auto-approve commands assigning arithmetic expressions to integer shell variables, including `OPTIND` and `RANDOM`. The expression can still contain behavior that should not be skipped merely because its outer form looks like an assignment. Such commands now prompt for approval so you can inspect them first. This tightens an existing decision; it does not ban every integer-variable assignment.

items.original: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving commands that assign an arithmetic expression to an integer shell variable (e.g. `OPTIND=1/0`, `RANDOM=2+2`); these now prompt for approval

title.zh-TW: 模型已在正確位置時，不再誤報切換
title.en: Claude stops announcing model switches that never happened

body.zh-TW: 目前的 Opus 模型已經有 1M 上下文視窗（模型一次能參考的內容範圍）時，Claude Code 不會再提示你「切到 Opus 1M 可得 5x more context」。你本來就在那個容量上，提示既多餘也可能讓人誤以為還有另一個選項。另一個誤報發生在雲端工作階段：主機只是在建立時指定初始模型，Claude 過去卻會被告知模型已經換過。現在初始選擇不再被說成中途切換。⟦導航若一直叫你改走眼前這條路，會讓人懷疑自己是否走錯；它現在先看清所在路線，已經走對就不再播報轉向。⟧
body.en: When the current Opus model already has a 1M context window (the amount of material a model can consider at once), Claude Code no longer suggests switching to Opus 1M for “5x more context.” You are already using that capacity, so the tip was both redundant and misleading. A second false announcement affected cloud sessions: merely choosing the initial model at session creation caused Claude to be told that its model had changed. Initial selection is no longer described as a mid-session switch. ⟦Navigation that keeps telling you to turn onto the road already under your wheels makes you wonder whether you are lost. It now checks the route first and stays quiet when you are already there.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a "switch to Opus 1M for 5x more context" tip that appeared even when the current Opus model already has a 1M context window
Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude the model had changed when the host was only setting the session's initial model

title.zh-TW: 子代理預設模型可覆寫，Enterprise 改用 Opus 5
title.en: Subagent model defaults yield to explicit choices, and Enterprise gets Opus 5

body.zh-TW: ⟦公司可先指定公務車的預設車款，部門派車單或這次出勤的明確指定仍能換車；預設只補上沒選擇的空位，不會壓過已寫好的安排。⟧`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` 現在設定子代理的預設模型，不再強制覆蓋所有選擇。代理定義裡的 `model:` 與每次啟動子代理時明確指定的 model 都優先於環境變數，兩者彼此誰更優先則不在這次說明內。可直接參考完整 JSON 形狀：`{"env": {"CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL": "opus"}}`；其中 `opus` 只是範例值。席次制 Enterprise 訂閱的預設模型另改為 Opus 5，與其他高階方案一致。
body.en: ⟦A company may name a default fleet car, while a department's dispatch sheet or an explicit choice for this trip can still select another. The default fills an empty choice; it does not erase a written assignment.⟧ `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` now sets the default subagent model instead of overriding everything. Both an agent definition's `model:` and a model explicitly chosen for each spawn take precedence over the environment variable; this release does not state which of those two wins over the other. A complete JSON shape is `{"env": {"CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL": "opus"}}`; `opus` is only an example value. Seat-based Enterprise subscriptions now default to Opus 5, matching other premium plans.

items.original:
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to set the default subagent model rather than override everything: an agent definition's `model:` and an explicit per-spawn model now take precedence over it
Changed the default model for seat-based Enterprise subscriptions to Opus 5, matching other premium plans

title.zh-TW: 第三方模型的提交尾註改用 Claude Code 署名
title.en: Third-party models now use a Claude Code commit signature

body.zh-TW: 使用中的模型若不是 Claude Code 認得的 Claude 模型，Git 提交（保存一批程式變更的版本紀錄）不該替它冒用特定模型身分。這常見於設定自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 後接上的第三方模型。現在這類情況的預設提交尾註改為完整的 `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code`，把共同作者標成實際操作工具，而不是猜測背後是哪個模型。⟦文件蓋署名章時，章面應寫負責送件的單位；認不出代筆者，就不能隨便刻一個人名上去。⟧認可的 Claude 模型不在這項變更的條件內。
body.en: When the active model is not a recognized Claude model, a Git commit (a versioned record of code changes) should not guess a specific model identity. This commonly happens with a third-party model behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. The default commit trailer is now the exact `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code`, crediting the tool that performed the work instead of inventing who sits behind it. ⟦A signature stamp should name the office that actually submitted the document. If the ghostwriter cannot be identified, carving a random person's name into the stamp would be false.⟧ Recognized Claude models are outside this change's condition.

items.original: Changed the default commit trailer to `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code` when the active model isn't a recognized Claude model (e.g. third-party models behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)

title.zh-TW: $0 額度改為請成員詢問管理員
title.en: $0 usage-credit limits now point members to their admin

body.zh-TW: ⟦公司的零用金額度若由主管設成 $0，櫃檯不該只說你已把錢花完；正確下一步是請主管確認安排。現在提示會把人帶向能處理設定的人。⟧Team 與 Enterprise 成員執行 `/usage-credits` 時，若管理員把組織用量額度上限設為 $0，過去訊息會說已達上限，容易讓人以為是自己用光額度。現在畫面改為提議詢問管理員。它沒有自行提高額度，也沒有繞過組織限制；只把原因與處理方向說對，讓成員知道這是管理設定，而非一般消耗到頂。
body.en: ⟦If a manager sets the company petty-cash allowance to $0, the clerk should not merely say that you spent it all. The useful next step is to ask the manager about the arrangement, and the notice now points to the person who can change it.⟧ When Team and Enterprise members run `/usage-credits` under an organization limit of $0, the old message said the cap had been reached, which sounded like ordinary consumption. It now suggests asking the admin. The command neither raises the limit nor bypasses organization policy; it correctly identifies this as an administrative setting and gives the member an appropriate next action.

items.original: Fixed `/usage-credits` for Team and Enterprise members whose admin set the org's usage-credit limit to $0: it now offers to ask the admin instead of saying a cap was reached

title.zh-TW: Claude apps gateway 不再誤用舊 Anthropic 設定檔
title.en: Claude apps gateway ignores stored Anthropic profiles it does not use

body.zh-TW: 透過 Claude apps gateway（集中轉送 Claude 請求的通道）開工作階段時，電腦裡可能還存著另一份 Anthropic 設定檔，例如 `Console` 登入資料。實際請求根本不使用那份設定，Claude Code 過去卻把它列為使用中，放進 `/status`；gateway 回覆 401 時，還會拿它再試一次。現在存著但未使用的設定檔不再出現在狀態，也不再參與 401 重試。⟦錢包裡過期的會員卡可以留著，但收銀台不能把它列進有效卡清單，更不能刷卡失敗後又拿同一張過期卡重刷。⟧
body.en: A Claude apps gateway session (one whose requests pass through a central relay) may coexist with a stored Anthropic profile, such as a Console sign-in. Requests never use that profile, yet Claude Code used to list it as active in `/status`. When the gateway returned 401, it also retried with the unused profile. Stored but inactive profiles are now omitted from status and from those 401 retries. ⟦An expired membership card may stay in your wallet, but a checkout counter must not list it among valid cards or swipe it again after payment fails.⟧ The change aligns displayed and retry state with the credentials the gateway session actually uses.

items.original: Fixed Claude apps gateway sessions treating a stored Anthropic profile (e.g. a Console sign-in) as active: listing it in `/status` and retrying gateway 401s with it, though requests never use it

title.zh-TW: 主機代管 Bedrock 不再多等推論設定檔探索
title.en: Host-managed Bedrock sessions skip unnecessary inference-profile discovery

body.zh-TW: ⟦連鎖店由分店自行接客時，可能要查店內排班；若總部已把負責人連同工單交下來，分店就不必再翻一次名冊。兩條流程的起點不同，不能硬套同一段等待。⟧在 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST`（由主機替 Claude Code 管理供應商連線）環境下，例如 Claude Desktop，Amazon Bedrock 工作階段可能直接收到 Bedrock model ID 或 ARN。這些識別資訊既已由主機給定，工作階段現在不再等待推論設定檔探索。一般 Bedrock 流程沒有被描述成全面取消探索；修正只針對主機代管且已收到 model ID 或 ARN 的情況。
body.en: ⟦A branch may need to check its local roster when serving a customer on its own. If headquarters already sends the named worker with the job, the branch need not search that roster again; the two processes start with different information.⟧ Under `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` (where the host manages provider connectivity for Claude Code), such as Claude Desktop, an Amazon Bedrock session may receive a Bedrock model ID or ARN directly. With that identifier already supplied, the session no longer waits for inference-profile discovery. The change is limited to host-managed sessions given a model ID or ARN; it does not say that every Bedrock flow skips discovery.

items.original: Improved Amazon Bedrock session start under `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` (e.g. Claude Desktop): a session given a Bedrock model ID or ARN no longer waits for inference-profile discovery

title.zh-TW: 特殊供應商與停用遙測時，radio 和 PR 徽章仍可用
title.en: Radio and PR badges keep working across providers and without telemetry

body.zh-TW: Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry、Claude Platform on AWS，以及關閉遙測（傳回產品使用情況的資料）時，`/radio` 現在都能使用。在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測時，頁尾的 PR 徽章（顯示 GitHub 拉取請求狀態的小標記）也不再執行 `gh pr view`；它會透過 `gh auth token`、`GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 取得憑證，直接呼叫 GitHub API。⟦連鎖店裡，這些特殊分店都能照常播放店內廣播；但只有 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測的分店，會從自備看板直接讀總部同一份進度。⟧
body.en: `/radio` is now available on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, and when telemetry (product-usage data sent back to the service) is disabled. On Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry disabled, the footer PR badge (the small marker showing GitHub pull-request status) no longer runs `gh pr view`. It gets credentials through `gh auth token`, `GH_TOKEN`, or `GITHUB_TOKEN` and calls the GitHub API directly. ⟦In a chain, all these special branches can keep their in-store radio playing. But only branches on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry disabled use their own display board to read the same progress update directly from headquarters.⟧

items.original:
Changed `/radio` to be available on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS, and when telemetry is disabled
Changed the footer PR badge on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is off, to call the GitHub API directly (via `gh auth token`, `GH_TOKEN`, or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) instead of `gh pr view`

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段的錯誤訊息改說真正原因
title.en: Cloud-session errors now explain the real cause and next step

body.zh-TW: ⟦訂做西裝試穿時，師傅不會只丟一句不合身：他指出是哪一處車線、為什麼裂開；布料一時缺貨就請你下週再來，而不是要你重新量一次尺寸；排定後續修改時，也會說明哪些配件不能列進這張訂單。⟧代理連線在 Bash 指令期間被網路代理中斷時，工具結果會點出主機與原因，不再只有 `connection reset`。建立雲端工作階段遇到暫時性 GitHub 連線失敗時，訊息會叫你重試，不再誤導你重新設定 GitHub。`/schedule` 也會說明 Claude Code 裡設定的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器不能附加到雲端例行任務，而非只顯示沒有 MCP 連接器。
body.en: ⟦At a suit fitting, the tailor does not just say it does not fit: he points to the seam that split and why; if the cloth is briefly out of stock he asks you to come back next week rather than remeasure you; and when booking the alterations he says which accessories cannot go on that order.⟧ If a session's network proxy drops during a Bash command, the tool result names the host and reason instead of only `connection reset`. A transient GitHub failure during cloud-session creation now tells you to retry rather than redo GitHub setup. `/schedule` also explains that MCP servers configured in Claude Code cannot be attached to cloud routines, instead of merely reporting that no MCP connectors exist.

items.original:
Improved cloud sessions: when the session's network proxy drops a connection during a Bash command, the tool result now names the host and reason instead of only "connection reset"
Fixed cloud session creation advising GitHub setup after a transient GitHub connection failure — the message now says to retry instead
Improved `/schedule` to explain that MCP servers configured in Claude Code can't be attached to cloud routines, instead of a bare "No MCP connectors" message

title.zh-TW: 政策停用功能時，提示不再把原因說錯
title.en: Policy-disabled features now report the right reason quietly

body.zh-TW: 組織政策若關閉 Remote Control（從其他裝置操作目前工作階段的功能），Claude Code 現在只顯示一則安靜提示，不再把政策決定回報成執行失敗。停用 `/bug` 或 `/share` 時，訊息也不會誤說成 `/feedback` 被停用。若組織政策或環境變數真的關閉 `/feedback`，相關提示、`/help` 與拒絕訊息便不再建議使用它，避免把你引到同樣走不通的指令。⟦店家公休時，告示應寫「公休」，不是貼「設備故障」；真正停掉哪項服務，招牌也不該繼續叫客人去用。⟧
body.en: When organization policy disables Remote Control (the feature for operating a current session from another device), Claude Code now shows one quiet notice instead of reporting the policy decision as a failure. Disabling `/bug` or `/share` no longer produces a message claiming that `/feedback` was disabled. When policy or an environment variable truly disables `/feedback`, tips, `/help`, and refusal messages also stop recommending it, so users are not sent toward a command that cannot work. ⟦A closed shop should post “closed,” not “equipment broken.” If a service is genuinely unavailable, its signs should not keep inviting customers to use it.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control reporting a failure when an organization's policy disables it; it now shows a single quiet notice instead
Fixed disabled `/bug` and `/share` reporting that `/feedback` was disabled; tips, `/help`, and refusal messages no longer suggest `/feedback` when an org policy or env var turns it off

title.zh-TW: ultrareview 起不來時會提早報告原因
title.en: Ultrareview stops early when its cloud session cannot start

body.zh-TW: ⟦班機若已確定取消，機場應當下廣播原因，而不是讓旅客在登機口坐滿 30 分鐘才說。`ultrareview` 現在也會在起飛失敗確定後提早結束。⟧執行 `claude ultrareview` 或 `/ultrareview` 時，背後需要啟動雲端工作階段。過去只要這個工作階段起不來，指令仍可能等滿 30 分鐘才停止，使用者只能看著它懸著。現在會提早停下並報告真正原因。這是失敗路徑的改善；雲端工作階段能正常啟動時，原有的 ultrareview 流程照常進行。
body.en: ⟦Once a flight is known to be canceled, the airport should announce why immediately rather than leave passengers at the departure area for the full 30 minutes. `ultrareview` now ends early once launch failure is known.⟧ Running `claude ultrareview` or `/ultrareview` requires a cloud session to start behind the command. If that session failed to start, the command could still wait the full 30 minutes while the user watched it hang. It now stops early and reports the reason. This improves the failure path; when the cloud session starts normally, the existing ultrareview flow proceeds as before.

items.original: Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `/ultrareview` waiting the full 30 minutes when the cloud session fails to start; they now stop early and report the reason

title.zh-TW: 原生執行檔縮小，少用語言高亮也移除
title.en: The native binary shrinks and drops six rarely used highlighters

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 的原生執行檔（可直接由作業系統執行的程式檔）先縮小了約 5 MB。另一項精簡移除了六種少用語言的語法高亮，讓執行檔再小 2.5 MB；這六種是 1c、gml、isbl、mathematica、maxima 與 sqf。語法高亮是依程式結構替文字上色，移除後受影響的是這些語言的彩色顯示，不代表整套語言支援都被宣告移除。⟦搬家時先把大件行李壓縮，再丟掉六套沒在用的裝飾用品；兩次各自省下空間，但不把兩個數字偷偷合成另一個總數。⟧
body.en: The Claude Code native binary (a program file the operating system can run directly) is now about 5 MB smaller. A separate trim removes syntax highlighting for six rarely used languages and makes the binary another 2.5 MB smaller: 1c, gml, isbl, mathematica, maxima, and sqf. Syntax highlighting colors text according to code structure, so the stated removal concerns colored display for those languages; it does not announce removal of every form of language support. ⟦While moving, first compress a large case, then discard six unused sets of decorations. Each step saves its own space, and the two figures should not be silently turned into a new total.⟧

items.original:
Improved install size: the native binary is about 5 MB smaller
Removed syntax highlighting for six rarely used languages (1c, gml, isbl, mathematica, maxima, sqf); the binary is 2.5 MB smaller

title.zh-TW: Chrome 瀏覽器動作統一走 Claude Code 權限檢查
title.en: Chrome browser actions now share Claude Code's permission checks

body.zh-TW: ⟦同一項申請原本有兩張核對表，填的人得猜該交哪份；現在都併入同一本登記簿，由同一位承辦人按同樣規則核對。⟧Claude in Chrome 發出的瀏覽器動作，現在一律經過 Claude Code 的權限檢查（執行動作前判斷是否需要你同意的步驟）。先前在關閉遙測的工作階段裡，這些動作會改由 Chrome 擴充功能自己的提示處理，因此同一類動作可能出現另一套詢問方式。修正後，即使遙測關閉，也不再繞到擴充功能的提示；這是把既有權限流程統一，不是讓瀏覽器動作免問就執行。
body.en: ⟦One application used to have two checking forms, forcing people to guess which one to submit. They now merge into one register, where the same clerk checks them by the same rules.⟧ Browser actions from Claude in Chrome now always pass through Claude Code's permission checks (the step that decides whether an action needs your consent). In sessions with telemetry disabled, those actions previously switched to the Chrome extension's own prompts, so identical actions could present a different approval path. They no longer detour to extension prompts when telemetry is off. This unifies the existing permission process; it does not make browser actions run without review.

items.original: Changed Claude in Chrome so browser actions always go through Claude Code's permission checks, including in sessions with telemetry disabled, which previously used the Chrome extension's own prompts

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求工作樹直接抓正確 ref
title.en: GitLab merge-request worktrees fetch the correct ref directly

body.zh-TW: 在 `gitlab.com` 來源的專案裡，可用合併請求編號搭配 `--worktree --tmux` 開工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開工作副本的功能）。Claude Code 現在會直接抓 GitLab ref；ref 是 Git 指向特定版本的名稱。過去它會先照 GitHub 的方式嘗試抓取；因為來源明明是 GitLab，這一步注定失敗，之後才走正確流程。修正移除了這段無效嘗試，讓既有功能從一開始就採用與來源相符的抓取方式。⟦維修中心看到機身品牌後，應直接查該品牌的零件流程；若先翻另一家手冊、等查無資料才換本，只會多走一段已知錯路。⟧
body.en: For a repository whose origin is `gitlab.com`, a merge-request number with `--worktree --tmux` opens a worktree (Git's feature for making a parallel working copy). Claude Code now fetches the GitLab ref directly; a ref names a particular Git revision. It previously tried a GitHub-style fetch first, but that attempt was doomed because the origin was GitLab. Removing the known-bad attempt lets the existing feature use a fetch method that matches the source from the start. ⟦A repair center should read the parts procedure for the brand printed on the machine. Opening another manufacturer's manual first and waiting for an inevitable miss only adds a detour.⟧

items.original: Fixed `--worktree --tmux` with a merge-request number on a gitlab.com origin trying a doomed GitHub-style fetch first instead of fetching the GitLab ref directly

title.zh-TW: gateway 登入前不再過早關閉分析數據
title.en: Gateway requirements no longer disable analytics before sign-in

body.zh-TW: ⟦換到另一間門市，不代表你進門前就得停止原本的記帳習慣；真正完成門市登記，或你明確要求停記，帳本才維持關閉。⟧分析數據（用來了解產品使用情況的資料）過去可能只因受管設定強制 gateway 登入，就在登入前關閉；連受管設定讀不到時也會如此。現在這兩種登入前狀況不再單獨觸發關閉。登入 gateway 之後，或透過 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 關閉時，分析數據才維持停用。完整 JSON 範例是 `{"env": {"DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "true"}}`；其中 `true` 是示範值。
body.en: ⟦Moving to another branch does not mean you must stop keeping accounts before entering. The ledger stays closed only after the branch registration is complete or when you explicitly ask to stop recording.⟧ Analytics (data used to understand product usage) could previously turn off before sign-in solely because managed settings required gateway login. The same happened when managed settings could not be read. Neither pre-sign-in condition now disables analytics by itself. Analytics stay off after signing in to the gateway or through `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`. A complete JSON example is `{"env": {"DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "true"}}`; `true` is an example value.

items.original: Changed analytics to no longer turn off before sign-in solely because managed settings force gateway login (or cannot be read); they stay off once signed in to the gateway or via `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`

title.zh-TW: VSCode 登入連結到正確章節，Remote Control 改成頁尾膠囊
title.en: VS Code fixes provider links and moves Remote Control into a footer pill

body.zh-TW: ⟦展場攤位不必用大型橫幅一直擋住視線；需要提醒時，在腳邊放一塊小立牌，既看得到，也能指出下一個攤位。VSCode 現在把 Remote Control 提示收成這種頁尾膠囊。⟧膠囊只在 Remote Control 開啟或失敗時顯示，點擊會到 `claude.ai/code` 開啟該工作階段，並可用 `/remote-control` 開關。登入畫面的 `Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex` 按鈕也改為直達第三方供應商設定章節，不再只開文件頂端。兩項調整都在 VSCode 介面：一項縮小持續提示，一項讓設定入口落在真正有用的位置。
body.en: ⟦A trade-show booth need not block the view with a huge banner all day. A small sign near the floor can appear when needed and point visitors to the next booth; VS Code now treats Remote Control that way.⟧ Its footer pill appears only while Remote Control is on or has failed. Clicking it opens that session at `claude.ai/code`, and `/remote-control` turns the feature on or off. On the sign-in screen, the `Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex` button now opens the third-party provider setup section rather than the top of the documentation. One change reduces persistent visual weight; the other lands users at the relevant setup instructions.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen's "Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex" button opening the docs at the top of the page instead of the third-party provider setup section
[VSCode] Changed the Remote Control banner to a footer pill (shown while Remote Control is on or has failed) that opens the session on claude.ai/code; turn it on or off with `/remote-control`

entries: Added `--restricted` (or `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`): removes the built-in tools that run commands or code and `WebFetch` (unless named in `--tools`), keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses `bypassPermissions`, and ignores user, project and local settings files
Added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter: a per-agent prompt cache TTL used when no subagent TTL setting is configured
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>` (or `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`) to override the label the runner registers with (default: hostname)

Added server-managed settings diagnostics: a startup warning when the settings fail to load, and a `/doctor` and `/status` line explaining a load failure or why they weren't fetched (Bedrock/Vertex/third-party provider, custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)
Added a warning in `/web-setup` when the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope, since pushes to very large repositories can be rejected without it
Added `/usage-credits` for Enterprise organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials, so members can request a higher usage limit from their admin
Added cross-session messaging (`SendMessage` / `ListAgents`) between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled
Fixed a prompt-cache miss (and lost extended-thinking context) roughly once an hour in long sessions, caused by tool definitions being re-rendered after an OAuth token refresh

Fixed the `ScheduleWakeup` tool definition changing between a session and its `--resume` when the account had entered usage overage, causing a full prompt-cache miss on the resumed session's first turn

Fixed Claude Desktop and Cowork sessions disappearing after 30 days: the transcript cleanup now keeps desktop-written sessions while they are in the app (unless org policy manages retention); the new `desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays` setting caps the exemption
Fixed being sent to the login screen when another Claude Code process held the token refresh lock while the session token had expired; the request now fails with a retryable error instead
Windows: Fixed the `claude agents` list not responding to the keyboard after detaching from a session, or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode

Fixed the recommended Console sign-in in `/login` failing with an OAuth error before showing a sign-in URL on machines where it can't be used (for example when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an API key helper is set); it now falls back to the API-key sign-in
Fixed model names in `/model` and fast-mode switch notices to render as code, so suffixes like `[1m]` display literally instead of as a link
Fixed `claude agents` skipping the workspace trust prompt when the `CI` environment variable is set
Fixed `claude agents` crashing on launch when the PR-status cache held a malformed entry
Fixed agent view resurrecting a weeks-old background session after the machine was off: such a session now shows as stopped at its real end, and opening it asks before resuming its saved conversation
Fixed agent view sometimes opening an older conversation, and dropping the typed prompt, when starting a new session
Fixed `claude agents`: opening a stopped session that you already resumed in another terminal no longer starts a second process on that conversation; the row now says it is open in a terminal

Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to delete a session ("has commits that are not pushed anywhere") when its worktree branch was already merged into your checked-out default branch (e.g. local `main`) but not yet pushed
Fixed background sessions waiting silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer: the `claude agents` row now names the hook and the schema error
Fixed hooks silently treating a stdout `{…}` object that isn't valid JSON as plain text; it's now reported as a hook error with the parse message
Fixed `/mcp` listing a project `.mcp.json` entry that declares the claude.ai connector type under the trusted "claude.ai" heading; it now appears under its real scope
Fixed MCP servers whose `headersHelper` supplies the `Authorization` header falling into OAuth discovery on a 401 instead of re-running the helper and retrying the call as documented
Fixed `/login` to a Claude apps gateway hanging when the managed-settings security approval dialog was required
Fixed gateway model discovery (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`) never running when `apiKeyHelper` is the only credential
Fixed `claude logs` leaving mouse tracking, bracketed paste and the alternate screen switched on in the terminal it was run from
Fixed the trust dialog's list of repo permission rules showing a garbled character when a long rule was cut off in the middle of an emoji
Fixed the permission mode indicator staying hidden behind the "Press Ctrl-C again to exit" hint when you press shift+tab right after ctrl+c

Fixed `/ultrareview` and locally seeded cloud sessions uploading uncommitted edits to `prod.env`-style and `*.tfvars` files, or to editor swap, temp, and backup copies of credential files (e.g. `key.pem.tmp`, `id_rsa.swo`); they now stay on your machine
Fixed Remote Control sessions occasionally never showing a permission prompt or the latest messages on the connected device after the CLI silently reconnected
Fixed cloud sessions occasionally failing at startup when the container's session credentials were not yet readable
Fixed `claude remote-control` rejecting its own flags (e.g. `--spawn`, `--name`) when a global flag or a wrapper-injected option precedes the subcommand
Fixed startup warnings (e.g. "N MCP servers need authentication") rendering one column right of the rest of the transcript
Fixed a backgrounded worktree session losing its checkout: the background session now holds the worktree's lock while it runs, so cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone
Fixed @-mentions of other sessions not matching names typed with non-Latin characters (for example Korean entered through an IME)
Fixed an invalid `crossSessionInbound` value being silently ignored: it now warns and holds cross-session messages (user settings) or refuses them (managed settings) until fixed
Fixed rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages telling you to run `/usage-credits` when that command isn't available for your organization (e.g. hidden with `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND`)
[VSCode] Fixed a chat tab getting stuck on "No conversation found" when its session was never saved; it now starts a new conversation instead
Improved the Workflow tool's prompt footprint: its description is now about 1k tokens instead of 5.7k, with the script-writing reference moved into a bundled `workflow-authoring` skill
Improved the prompt-footer PR badge to check GitHub less often while the pull request is unchanged; a push or a `gh pr` command still refreshes it right away
Improved managed settings: client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt

Improved `/ultrareview <PR#>` to check before launch that the GitHub account connected to your Claude account can access the repository, and to explain how to fix it, instead of failing after the cloud session starts
Improved cross-session messaging: falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory when the default one can't be used, and the notice and `/status` name the directory to fix
Changed shift+enter in the agent view dispatch input to insert a newline (matching the prompt); ctrl+enter now dispatches and attaches
Changed `/loop`: self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are now always available, including on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry
Changed Anthropic telemetry export failures to log at debug level as `[Anthropic telemetry]` instead of `[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error`, so they are not mistaken for your OTel collector failing
Changed cross-session messaging in Linux user namespaces: root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories
Changed `SendMessage` from a subagent to another session: the result now notes that any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to the subagent

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段不再定期忘掉前文
title.en: Long sessions stop losing cached context

body.zh-TW: 長工作階段裡請 Claude 處理複雜工作，最怕它途中重新整理工具說明，連延伸思考的脈絡也跟著掉了。⟦這像廚房備料檯每隔一段時間又把切好的材料倒回去重切；現在 OAuth token 更新後，工具定義不會重排，備好的料能原樣接著用。⟧先前這種提示詞快取（把已處理內容暫存起來直接用）失效大約每小時發生一次。帳號進入用量超額後再用 `--resume` 接續時，`ScheduleWakeup` 的定義也固定了，第一輪不會因此整份重算。
body.en: A long, complex Claude session could lose its extended-thinking context when tool definitions were rendered again after an OAuth token refresh. ⟦It was a prep counter where chopped ingredients were periodically dumped out and cut again; the prepared ingredients now stay in place.⟧ The roughly hourly prompt-cache miss is fixed. `ScheduleWakeup` also keeps the same definition on the first `--resume` turn after an account enters usage overage, avoiding a full cache miss.

items.original:
Fixed a prompt-cache miss (and lost extended-thinking context) roughly once an hour in long sessions, caused by tool definitions being re-rendered after an OAuth token refresh
Fixed the `ScheduleWakeup` tool definition changing between a session and its `--resume` when the account had entered usage overage, causing a full prompt-cache miss on the resumed session's first turn

title.zh-TW: 受限模式只留下較安全的工具
title.en: Restricted mode narrows tools and settings

body.zh-TW: 想讓 Claude Code 在較窄的範圍內工作，可直接啟動 `claude --restricted`，或執行 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1 claude`。它會移除能執行指令或程式碼的內建工具，也移除 `WebFetch`；若在 `--tools` 明確點名，該工具仍可保留，所以這不等於完全斷網。檔案工具只能碰工作目錄，`bypassPermissions` 會被拒絕，user、project、local 三種設定檔都會忽略。⟦好比出差只帶精簡工具包：不是把外界封死，而是只帶這趟明確需要、且活動範圍受限的器材。⟧
body.en: Run `claude --restricted`, or `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1 claude`, when Claude Code should work within a narrower boundary. It removes built-in tools that execute commands or code and removes `WebFetch`, unless you explicitly name a tool in `--tools`; this is not a promise of no network access. File tools stay inside the working directory, `bypassPermissions` is refused, and user, project, and local settings files are ignored. ⟦Think of packing a small work kit for a trip: it contains only the named equipment, and that equipment has a limited work area.⟧

items.original: Added `--restricted` (or `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`): removes the built-in tools that run commands or code and `WebFetch` (unless named in `--tools`), keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses `bypassPermissions`, and ignores user, project and local settings files

title.zh-TW: 每個代理可指定提示詞保存期
title.en: Each agent can set a prompt-cache lifetime

body.zh-TW:
不同代理需要保留提示詞多久，現在能寫進各自的代理檔頭。⟦像冰箱裡每盒剩菜各貼保存期限，reviewer 可留久一點，短任務則早點清掉，不必整台冰箱共用同一張標籤。⟧`experimental.cacheTtl` 可設為 `"5m"` 或 `"1h"`，代表提示詞快取（把已處理內容暫存起來直接用）的存活期。只有未另外設定子代理 TTL 時，這個每代理值才會生效。可複製以下片段到代理檔頭：
```
---
name: reviewer
experimental:
  cacheTtl: "1h"
---
```
body.en:
An agent can now carry its own prompt-cache lifetime in its frontmatter. ⟦It is like putting a separate use-by label on each container in a refrigerator instead of giving the entire refrigerator one date.⟧ Set `experimental.cacheTtl` to `"5m"` or `"1h"`. This per-agent value is used only when no subagent TTL setting has been configured. Copy this frontmatter example:
```
---
name: reviewer
experimental:
  cacheTtl: "1h"
---
```

items.original: Added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter: a per-agent prompt cache TTL used when no subagent TTL setting is configured

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器可改用好認的標籤
title.en: Self-hosted runners can register a clearer label

body.zh-TW:
一排自架執行器若都只顯示主機名稱，管理時不一定看得出各自的用途。現在可用 `--client-label` 覆寫註冊標籤；不指定時仍以主機名稱為預設。直接執行：
```
claude self-hosted-runner --client-label ci-box-3
```
也能先設環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的外部設定）：
```
export SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL=ci-box-3
```
兩種寫法都會覆寫註冊標籤。⟦這像搬家紙箱不再只寫「第 N 箱」，而是標成「廚房」或「書房」；內容沒變，找箱子的人卻能從標籤直接知道用途。⟧
body.en:
A row of self-hosted runners labeled only by hostname can be hard to identify. Override the registration label with `--client-label`; hostname remains the default. Run:
```
claude self-hosted-runner --client-label ci-box-3
```
Or set the environment variable:
```
export SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL=ci-box-3
```
Both forms override the registration label. ⟦It is a moving box labeled by room instead of only “box N”: the contents do not change, but the person sorting boxes knows where it belongs.⟧

items.original: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>` (or `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`) to override the label the runner registers with (default: hostname)

title.zh-TW: 受管設定抓不到時會說明原因
title.en: Managed-settings failures now explain themselves

body.zh-TW: 公司集中下發的設定若沒載入，使用者以前只看到結果，難以判斷從哪裡查起。⟦像大樓物業公告不只寫「服務未啟用」，還貼出是資料載入失敗，或這棟樓本來就不向該來源取件。⟧現在開機會先顯示警告；`/doctor` 與 `/status` 也會多一行診斷，說明載入失敗，或為何根本沒有抓取。後者涵蓋 Bedrock、Vertex、第三方供應商，以及自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`。這些訊息不會替你修設定，但會把排查起點直接放到畫面上。
body.en: A centrally managed setting could fail to load without giving users a useful starting point. ⟦Now the building-management notice says whether the records failed to load or whether this building never fetches from that source.⟧ Startup shows a warning, while `/doctor` and `/status` add a line explaining the load failure or why settings were not fetched. The latter covers Bedrock, Vertex, third-party providers, and a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. It is diagnosis, not an automatic repair.

items.original: Added server-managed settings diagnostics: a startup warning when the settings fail to load, and a `/doctor` and `/status` line explaining a load failure or why they weren't fetched (Bedrock/Vertex/third-party provider, custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)

title.zh-TW: 例行環境變數不再要求核准設定
title.en: Routine managed-setting variables stop asking for approval

body.zh-TW: 管理員調整 client-side timeout、MCP startup-mode 或 stream-watchdog 的環境變數後，Claude Code 不會再跳出設定核准提示。環境變數是程式啟動時讀取的外部設定；這次原文沒有公布各自的確切變數名稱，因此不該自行猜名稱照抄。改動只縮減這幾類受管設定的確認干擾，沒有說其他設定也免核准。⟦沿用物業管理的故事，這等於例行調整空調等候時間、設備啟動方式與監看器時，不必每次再請住戶簽一張同意單。⟧
body.en: Changing the managed environment variables for client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, or stream-watchdog no longer triggers a settings-approval prompt. The changelog does not provide their exact variable names, so there is no new name to copy from this card. The exemption is limited to those categories. ⟦In the same property-management office, routine adjustments to equipment timing and monitoring no longer require a fresh resident signature.⟧

items.original: Improved managed settings: client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt

title.zh-TW: 大型儲存庫推送前先提醒 workflow 權限
title.en: Web setup warns about a missing workflow scope

body.zh-TW: 用 `/web-setup` 準備 GitHub 流程時，如果 GitHub CLI token（命令列工具使用的授權令牌）缺少 `workflow` scope，畫面現在會先警告你。scope 是這張令牌被允許做的事。缺少它時，對非常大的儲存庫執行 push 可能被拒絕；原文說的是「可能」，不是每次都會失敗，也不是 `/web-setup` 會自動補權限。⟦居家水電施工前，師傅先看電表容量能不能帶動大型機具：容量不夠時，大工程可能跳電，所以先提醒你確認；他不會說工程一定做不成，也不會替你換電表。⟧
body.en: During `/web-setup`, Claude Code now warns if the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope. Without that scope, a push to a very large repository can be rejected. This is a warning about a possible failure, not a claim that every push will fail, and `/web-setup` does not grant the scope for you. ⟦Before household electrical work, an electrician checks whether the meter capacity can run heavy equipment: insufficient capacity may trip the power during a large job, so it is a prompt to check, not a claim that the work cannot happen or an offer to replace the meter.⟧

items.original: Added a warning in `/web-setup` when the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope, since pushes to very large repositories can be rejected without it

title.zh-TW: 企業成員可向管理員申請提高用量
title.en: Eligible enterprise members can request more usage

body.zh-TW: 企業組織的成員碰到用量上限時，多了一個清楚的申請入口：`/usage-credits` 會讓你向管理員要求提高上限。適用對象是透過 AWS Marketplace 計費、自助企業版與企業試用的組織。另一方面，限流（短時間請求太多而被暫緩）、用量與快速模式訊息，若偵測到你的組織沒有這個指令，就不再叫你執行它；例如管理員用 `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND` 隱藏時也算。⟦它像公司採購與請款窗口：符合制度的人有表可送，不提供這項流程的部門也不會收到「請去填那張不存在的表」的通知。⟧
body.en: Members of eligible Enterprise organizations can now run `/usage-credits` to ask an administrator for a higher usage limit. Eligibility covers organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials. Rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages also stop recommending the command when the organization does not offer it, including when `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND` hides it. ⟦It works like a company purchasing office: eligible staff get a request form, while departments without that process are not told to submit a form that does not exist.⟧

items.original:
Added `/usage-credits` for Enterprise organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials, so members can request a higher usage limit from their admin
Fixed rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages telling you to run `/usage-credits` when that command isn't available for your organization (e.g. hidden with `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND`)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳訊支援更多環境
title.en: Cross-session messaging reaches more environments

body.zh-TW: 同一台機器上的工作階段，現在可在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry，以及關閉遙測（回傳運作資料供觀察）的情況下使用 `SendMessage` 與 `ListAgents`。⟦它像辦公室桌間的氣送管：膠囊不只通往原本的桌區，新區也接上管路；預設投入口故障時，還會改走每位使用者各自私有的備用管。⟧預設 `/tmp` 無法使用時，備援位置是每位使用者私有的 `/tmp` 目錄，通知與 `/status` 會說明實際目錄，方便修正。用輸入法打出的韓文等非拉丁名稱，如今也能被其他工作階段的 @ 提及正確比對。
body.en: Sessions on the same machine can now use `SendMessage` and `ListAgents` on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled. ⟦Picture pneumatic tubes between office desks: more office sections now connect, and a broken default chute sends each person's capsules through that person's private backup tube.⟧ If the default `/tmp` cannot be used, messaging falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory; the notice and `/status` name it. Mentions also match non-Latin session names, including Korean entered through an IME.

items.original:
Added cross-session messaging (`SendMessage` / `ListAgents`) between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled
Improved cross-session messaging: falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory when the default one can't be used, and the notice and `/status` name the directory to fix
Fixed @-mentions of other sessions not matching names typed with non-Latin characters (for example Korean entered through an IME)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息的路由與信任更嚴謹
title.en: Cross-session routes and trust become stricter

body.zh-TW: `crossSessionInbound` 若填成無效值，現在不會再靜默略過。這個鍵位於 `~/.claude/settings.json`；原文沒有列有效值，因此只能確認要改成文件所列的有效值。user settings 會先警告並暫扣跨工作階段訊息，managed settings 則警告並拒收，兩者都維持到設定修正為止。Linux 使用者命名空間裡，對未對應擁有者的 root 等效信任縮到正規系統目錄。子代理替父工作階段向別處執行 `SendMessage` 時，回覆會回到父工作階段的對話。⟦仍是桌間氣送管：錯標籤的膠囊會被暫放或退回，內部管線的認定範圍縮小，代送件的回覆則送回委託人的桌面。⟧
body.en: An invalid `crossSessionInbound` value is no longer ignored. The key lives in `~/.claude/settings.json`; the changelog lists no valid values, so choose one from the documentation. User settings warn and hold cross-session messages, while managed settings warn and refuse them, in both cases until fixed. In Linux user namespaces, root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories. A reply to a subagent's `SendMessage` goes to the parent session conversation. ⟦The office tubes now hold or return a capsule with a bad route label, narrow what counts as internal pipework, and return a delegated reply to the sender's own desk.⟧

items.original:
Fixed an invalid `crossSessionInbound` value being silently ignored: it now warns and holds cross-session messages (user settings) or refuses them (managed settings) until fixed
Changed cross-session messaging in Linux user namespaces: root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories
Changed `SendMessage` from a subagent to another session: the result now notes that any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to the subagent

title.zh-TW: 代理看板不再復活舊工作或重複開工
title.en: Agent view stops reviving or duplicating old work

body.zh-TW: 背景工作隔著關機再回來，最需要的是看清它真正停在哪。⟦工作坊的工單看板現在照實把數週前的工單標在停工點；要重開會先問，而不是工坊一開門就讓舊機器自行轉起來。⟧新建工作階段也不再誤開較舊的對話，或吞掉你剛打的提示。若一個已停止的工作階段早已在另一個終端機接續，再從 `claude agents` 打開不會啟動第二個行程；該列會直接說它已在某個終端機開啟。
body.en: After a machine wakes, you need to know where background work really stopped. ⟦The workshop job board now leaves a weeks-old ticket at its true stopping point and asks before restarting it, instead of powering old machinery as soon as the shop opens.⟧ A new session no longer opens an older conversation or drops the prompt you typed. Opening a stopped session already resumed in another terminal does not start a second process; its `claude agents` row says it is open in a terminal.

items.original:
Fixed agent view resurrecting a weeks-old background session after the machine was off: such a session now shows as stopped at its real end, and opening it asks before resuming its saved conversation
Fixed agent view sometimes opening an older conversation, and dropping the typed prompt, when starting a new session
Fixed `claude agents`: opening a stopped session that you already resumed in another terminal no longer starts a second process on that conversation; the row now says it is open in a terminal

title.zh-TW: 代理看板的鍵盤與按鍵分工恢復正常
title.en: Agent board keyboard input and key roles work again

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 從工作階段卸離後，或終端機分頁仍留在 win32-input-mode 時，`claude agents` 清單不再對鍵盤沒反應。派工輸入框的按鍵也分清工作：shift+enter 插入換行，ctrl+enter 才會派工並附加。⟦同一座工作坊的工單看板上，卸下工單或換到特殊書寫模式後，筆仍能在清單上劃記；寫到下一行與把工單送去處理，也各有自己的按鍵。⟧
body.en: On Windows, the `claude agents` list responds to the keyboard again after detaching from a session or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode. The dispatch input also gives its keys distinct jobs: shift+enter inserts a newline, while ctrl+enter dispatches and attaches. ⟦On the same workshop job board, the pen still marks the list after detaching a job or entering a special writing mode; starting a new line and sending the job onward each have their own key.⟧

items.original:
Windows: Fixed the `claude agents` list not responding to the keyboard after detaching from a session, or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode
Changed shift+enter in the agent view dispatch input to insert a newline (matching the prompt); ctrl+enter now dispatches and attaches

title.zh-TW: 代理看板啟動時的信任與資料防護補好
title.en: Agent board startup keeps its trust check and survives bad data

body.zh-TW: 打開 `claude agents` 時，該問的工作區信任提示不會因設定了 `CI` 環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的設定值）就被跳過。PR 狀態快取（把查過的合併請求結果暫存起來）混入損壞資料時，啟動也不再崩潰。⟦同一座工作坊的工單看板前，值班人員仍會要求你先確認能否使用工作區；即使收納盒混進一張損壞工單，也不會讓整塊看板在開門時倒下。⟧
body.en: When `claude agents` opens, setting the `CI` environment variable no longer skips the workspace trust prompt. A malformed entry in the PR-status cache also no longer crashes launch. ⟦At the same workshop job board, the attendant still asks you to confirm use of the workspace; even a damaged ticket mixed into the tray does not make the whole board collapse when the door opens.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents` skipping the workspace trust prompt when the `CI` environment variable is set
Fixed `claude agents` crashing on launch when the PR-status cache held a malformed entry

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤答錯不再讓背景工作乾等
title.en: Bad hook output no longer leaves agents waiting

body.zh-TW: 背景工作階段卡住不動時，原因若是 `PermissionRequest` 或 `PreToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）印出無效答案，`claude agents` 現在會直接列出掛鉤名稱與 schema error。schema error 是回覆結構不符規格。掛鉤 stdout（程式的一般文字輸出）若印出看似物件的 `{…}`，卻不是合法 JSON，也不再被當成普通文字略過，而會回報掛鉤錯誤與解析訊息。⟦如同收件櫃檯看不懂表單時，退回並標出哪一欄格式錯，而不是把表單壓在桌下，讓申請人永遠等不到消息。⟧
body.en: A background session no longer waits silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer. Its `claude agents` row names the hook and schema error. If hook stdout prints a `{…}` object that is not valid JSON, it is no longer accepted as plain text; Claude Code reports a hook error with the parse message. ⟦An intake clerk now returns an unreadable form with the bad field marked instead of placing it under the desk while the applicant waits forever.⟧

items.original:
Fixed background sessions waiting silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer: the `claude agents` row now names the hook and the schema error
Fixed hooks silently treating a stdout `{…}` object that isn't valid JSON as plain text; it's now reported as a hook error with the parse message

title.zh-TW: 背景工作樹不再被誤刪或誤判
title.en: Active worktrees stop being removed or misjudged

body.zh-TW: 工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）分支若已併入你簽出的預設分支，例如本機 `main`，即使還沒 push，`claude agents` 與 `claude rm` 也不會再以「有提交尚未推送」拒絕刪除。反過來，仍在執行的背景工作階段會持有工作樹的鎖。清理程序與 `git worktree remove` 會略過它，不會讓工作中的代理突然失去簽出內容。⟦這像共用熱座位的個人置物櫃：物品已歸檔就能正常清櫃，仍有人使用時則掛上鎖，清潔人員不會誤收。⟧
body.en: If a worktree branch is already merged into the checked-out default branch, such as local `main`, `claude agents` and `claude rm` no longer refuse deletion merely because that merge has not been pushed. Meanwhile, a running background session holds its worktree lock. Cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone instead of taking away its checkout. ⟦A shared-office locker can be cleared after its contents are filed, but remains locked while its owner is still using the desk.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to delete a session ("has commits that are not pushed anywhere") when its worktree branch was already merged into your checked-out default branch (e.g. local `main`) but not yet pushed
Fixed a backgrounded worktree session losing its checkout: the background session now holds the worktree's lock while it runs, so cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone

title.zh-TW: token 更新鎖碰撞時改成可重試
title.en: Token-refresh contention becomes retryable

body.zh-TW: 另一個 Claude Code 行程正在更新 token（用來證明登入狀態的授權令牌），剛好你的工作階段 token 又過期時，過去會直接把你送回登入畫面。⟦電話總機遇到線路佔用，現在會給可重撥的佔線音，而不是把整通電話掛斷、叫你重新辦一次通話身分。⟧修正後，這次請求會以可重試的錯誤失敗。它沒有說請求會自動成功，也沒有改變登入方式；差別是短暫的更新鎖衝突不再被誤當成你需要重新登入。
body.en: If another Claude Code process holds the token-refresh lock just as the current session token expires, you are no longer sent to the login screen. ⟦The telephone exchange now returns a busy tone that invites a redial instead of disconnecting the call and making you establish your identity again.⟧ The request fails with a retryable error. It is still a failed request, not a promise of automatic success; the temporary lock conflict is simply no longer mistaken for a lost login.

items.original: Fixed being sent to the login screen when another Claude Code process held the token refresh lock while the session token had expired; the request now fails with a retryable error instead

title.zh-TW: 主控台登入不可用時改走 API 金鑰
title.en: Login falls back to an API key when Console sign-in cannot work

body.zh-TW: 有些機器已設定 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，或使用 API 金鑰輔助程式，因此無法採用 `/login` 建議的 Console 登入。以前流程還沒顯示登入網址，就先以 OAuth 錯誤中止。現在 `/login` 會改走 API 金鑰登入，讓既有憑證來源能接手。這是登入方式的備援，不是上一張 token 更新鎖的重試機制。⟦沿用電話總機的故事：指定分機打不通時，接線生改接另一條已有線路，而不是在播出號碼前就結束通話。⟧
body.en: Some machines cannot use the recommended Console sign-in because `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an API-key helper is set. `/login` used to stop with an OAuth error before even showing the sign-in URL.
