Improved the embedded `grep` in native macOS/Linux builds: pathological patterns now fail fast instead of exhausting memory, and `-m N` with `-A/-C` prints correct context
Improved the context-limit error to say when auto-compact is off and point to `/config` to re-enable it
Vim mode: NORMAL mode and cursor position are now preserved when toggling the detailed transcript (ctrl+o) or closing a panel
Dialogs: arrow keys and Enter pressed in quick succession now select the option you navigated to instead of the previously highlighted one
`SendMessage` now refuses messages too large for cross-session delivery up front instead of silently dropping them
Remote Control: `claude rc` now applies the same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup
[VSCode] Fixed focus jumping between open Claude tabs on its own when a window with several Claude panels is restored or reloaded

title.zh-TW: 輸入即時拼字檢查，打字時自動標記錯字
title.en: Optional real-time spellcheck underlines typos as you type

body.zh-TW:
在終端機裡打提示詞時，現在可以開啟即時拼字檢查。只要在個人設定檔中加入 `"spellcheck": true`，系統會使用你電腦裡安裝的 `aspell`、`hunspell` 或 `ispell` 等拼字檢查工具，在你邊輸入的同時即時標記拼錯的單字。若要啟用，可於 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中設定：
```json
{"spellcheck": true}
```
如此一來，在送出指令之前就能即時發現打錯的指令關鍵字或單字，不必等送出後才發現出錯。⟦像隨身帶著一位字詞校對員，當你在稿紙上寫錯英文單字時，他立刻在底下畫一條紅波浪線提醒。⟧
body.en:
You can now turn on real-time spelling feedback while entering a terminal prompt. When you enable the optional `spellcheck` setting, it uses your locally installed `aspell`, `hunspell`, or `ispell` tools to underline misspelled words as you type. To turn it on, add it to your `~/.claude/settings.json`:
```json
{"spellcheck": true}
```
This catches misspellings and prompt typos before you send the message. ⟦Like having a personal proofreader hovering over your shoulder to scribble a red squiggly line under any typo the moment you write it.⟧

items.original: Added an optional `spellcheck` setting that underlines misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using your installed `aspell`, `hunspell`, or `ispell`

title.zh-TW: 語言伺服器斷線重連，提示詞快取不再整批清空
title.en: Prompt cache survives language server disconnects and reconnects

body.zh-TW: 寫程式時若是語言伺服器在對話中斷線又重連，你不再需要心疼遺失的快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）與額外消耗的費用。過去在同一個工作階段（session）中，語言伺服器只要短暫斷開連線或重新接上，整個提示詞快取就會被徹底清空失效，迫使後續對話重新計算所有標記。現在這項問題已修正，連線中斷或重連時會妥善保留既有快取。⟦就像廚房的備料台暫時換人接手，切好的食材仍整齊留在原位，不必從洗菜、切菜全部重做。⟧
body.en: When language servers disconnect or reconnect in the middle of a session, your prompt cache will no longer be wiped clean. Previously, any brief hiccup or reconnection with a language server invalidated the entire prompt cache, forcing subsequent turns to re-process tokens and waste credits. The cache is now safely preserved across mid-session language server reconnections. ⟦Like a kitchen prep station changing hands for a moment while the chopped ingredients stay neatly in place, rather than making the next cook wash and chop everything again.⟧

items.original: Fixed whole-prompt-cache invalidation when a language server disconnected or reconnected mid-session

title.zh-TW: 多行提示詞高亮精準對齊，斜線指令不顯示網頁實體編碼
title.en: Multi-line prompt highlights align accurately, and slash commands stop showing raw HTML entities

body.zh-TW: 在多行提示詞中輸入斜線指令或關鍵字時，高亮標記不再往前或往後歪掉一兩個字元。以前在輸入框打入多行文字時，斜線指令、關鍵字以及標註（@mention，用小老鼠符號提及檔案或符號的語法）的高亮色彩有時會出現字元位移，看起來十分錯亂；同時，若在 Claude 正在輸出回覆的當下執行斜線指令，終端機也不會再把字元印成像 `&` 這樣的 HTML 實體編碼。⟦像剪輯軟體的時間軸：色帶會對準對應片段，播放中的新標註也以正常文字顯示，不會變成代碼。⟧
body.en: Multi-line prompt input highlighting and slash command characters now render cleanly. Previously, syntax highlights for slash commands, keywords, and `@` mentions could appear shifted by one or more characters across multi-line inputs. Additionally, running a slash command while Claude was actively streaming a response showed raw HTML entities instead of real characters. Both visual bugs are now resolved. ⟦Like a video editor's timeline: colored bands align with their clips, and annotations added during playback appear as normal text rather than code.⟧

items.original:
Fixed prompt input highlights (slash commands, keywords, mentions) appearing shifted by one or more characters in some multi-line prompts
Fixed slash commands run while Claude is responding showing HTML entities instead of the actual characters

title.zh-TW: 終端機 Markdown 清單排版修正，深層項目與折行對齊更工整
title.en: Terminal Markdown lists align properly at depth 3+ with hanging indents

body.zh-TW: 在終端機介面閱讀多層 Markdown 清單時，第 3 層或更深的項目現在會正確對齊，過長項目的換行也會使用懸掛縮排（hanging indent，讓換行後的第二行文字對齊上一行開頭而非標記點的排版方式）。過去，這些深層項目的對齊位置常常歪斜錯位，文字自動換行後也不會往內縮排。⟦整理層級分明的大綱筆記時，若第三層以下的縮排全歪掉，閱讀節奏便會被打亂。⟧
body.en: When you read deeply nested Markdown lists in the terminal UI, third-level and deeper items now align properly, and wrapped lines use a hanging indent. Previously, lists nested at depth 3 or deeper suffered from misalignment, and list items that wrapped across multiple lines lacked clean indentation. ⟦Like an outline notebook where third-level sub-bullets and long paragraphs wrap cleanly aligned with the text margin instead of drifting into a jagged, unreadable mess.⟧

items.original: Fixed nested markdown list items misaligning at depth 3+ and added a hanging indent to wrapped list items in the terminal UI

title.zh-TW: 授權確認框收緊安全防護，留言按鍵不再誤送全域編輯權限
title.en: Permission prompts tighten safety, preventing accidental blanket grants on Shift+Tab

body.zh-TW: 在權限授權對話框的留言欄位裡按 Shift+Tab，現在只會單純關閉該欄位，絕不會手滑把整個工作階段（session）的編輯權限直接送出去。以前在權限提示的備註框按下 Shift+Tab，會誤觸核准並賦予整個工作階段範圍的編輯權限；現在這個危險行為已被修正。此外，授權對話框的說明文字與「不再詢問」選項，現在保證與實際授權涵蓋的範圍完全一致；若對話框無法完整顯示內容，系統會主動隱藏「不再詢問」選項以策安全。⟦像食譜 App 裡按返回只收起備註欄；食譜內容沒顯示完整時，也先不提供「往後照做、不再確認」的選項。⟧
body.en: Permission prompts are now much safer and more accurate about what you grant. Previously, pressing Shift+Tab inside the permission comment field accidentally approved the edit and granted session-wide edit permissions instead of just closing the comment box. In addition, permission dialog text and "don't ask again" options now strictly match the true scope of the grant, and the "don't ask again" option is withheld whenever the full contents cannot be displayed. ⟦Like pressing Back in a recipe app to close only its notes field; when the full recipe is not shown, it also withholds an "always follow this without asking" option.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Shift+Tab inside the permission prompt's comment field approving the edit and granting session-wide edit permission instead of closing the field
Improved permission dialogs: display text and "don't ask again" options now always match what a grant would cover, and "don't ask again" is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed

title.zh-TW: 筆記本儲存格讀取失敗時，變更確認視窗主動說明原因
title.en: Notebook approval dialogs explain why unreadable cell contents could not be shown

body.zh-TW: 筆記本（notebook）儲存格無法讀取時，刪除或替換前的確認視窗不再一聲不吭地留下一片空白。以往當系統無法讀取 Jupyter 筆記本或特定儲存格的原始內容時，核准對話框會直接略過既有內容，讓使用者誤以為該儲存格原本就是空的；現在對話框會明確標註無法讀取的原因，幫助你在確認修改前了解真實狀況。⟦像醫院的檢驗螢幕遇到無法讀出的結果時，不再把欄位留白而讓人誤以為沒有資料，而會說明無法顯示的原因。⟧
body.en: Notebook cell delete and replace approval dialogs now state why content is missing when a read fails. Previously, if Claude could not read a notebook file or an individual cell, the approval dialog silently omitted the existing content, making it look as though you were deleting an empty cell. The dialog now explicitly explains why the existing content could not be read so you can make an informed decision before approving the change. ⟦Like a hospital test display that explains why a result cannot be shown rather than leaving the field blank and making it look as though no result exists.⟧

items.original: Fixed notebook cell delete/replace approval dialogs silently omitting the existing cell content when the notebook or cell could not be read; the dialog now says why

title.zh-TW: 選單對話框按鍵反應更即時，快按 Enter 精準選中當前目標
title.en: Rapid dialog navigation selects your actual destination on Enter

body.zh-TW: 在各類選單對話框裡快速連按方向鍵與 Enter，你選中的項目就是游標最後停下的那一項。以前如果你的手速非常快，按下方向鍵切換選項後立刻按下 Enter 確認，介面偶爾會跟不上你的按鍵節奏，導致送出的是前一個高亮停頓的舊選項，容易造成手滑選錯；現在對話框的鍵盤事件處理更加敏捷，能精準捕捉你瞬間移動到的目標。⟦猶如在自動販賣機上飛快按下一排按鈕時，出貨口掉出的確實是你最後停下的飲料，而不是前一毫秒還亮著燈的舊品項。⟧
body.en: Rapidly navigating dialogs with arrow keys and Enter now picks the correct option. Previously, if you tapped an arrow key and immediately pressed Enter in quick succession, the dialog sometimes lagged behind and selected the previously highlighted choice instead of the one you just moved to. Dialog keyboard handling is now properly synchronized to catch fast keystrokes. ⟦Like pressing buttons quickly on a vending machine and receiving the drink you actually stopped on, rather than the slot that was lit up a split second earlier.⟧

items.original: Dialogs: arrow keys and Enter pressed in quick succession now select the option you navigated to instead of the previously highlighted one

title.zh-TW: 代理工具缺少型態參數時，主動列出目前可用的代理清單
title.en: Agent tool lists available subagents when an omitted type lacks a default

body.zh-TW: 當你在工作階段（session）中呼叫 Agent 工具卻省略指定型態時，現在會直接收到可用代理的清楚清單。以前在某些不支援全能預設代理的特殊環境中，系統仍會聲稱有預設代理可用，導致執行時碰壁；現在若省略了 `subagent_type` 參數，它會直接回報明確的錯誤訊息，並條列出目前環境中實際可用的代理清單。⟦走進專門維修站請接待處派員協助，若今天沒有全能技師值班，櫃檯理應直接交給你一張「今日在場專家清單」，而不是口頭答應後才發現沒人可派。⟧
body.en: When you omit `subagent_type` while calling the Agent tool in a session without a general-purpose default, you now get a clear error listing the agents available to you. Previously, in sessions where the standard general-purpose agent was not supported, omitting the `subagent_type` parameter falsely advertised that a default was present. ⟦Like walking up to a specialized service desk and receiving a clear list of today's available technicians on duty instead of being told a general handyman is available when none exists.⟧

items.original: Fixed the Agent tool advertising a general-purpose default in sessions where that agent is unavailable: an omitted `subagent_type` there now gets a clear error listing the available agents

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息超重時直接拒收，不再無聲丟失資料
title.en: SendMessage rejects oversized cross-session payloads up front instead of dropping them

body.zh-TW: 跨工作階段（session）傳送訊息時，文字量如果超出傳輸上限，`SendMessage` 現在會當場拒絕收件。以前在不同工作階段之間傳遞超大型訊息時，系統會因為資料量過大而默默把訊息丟棄，呼叫端完全收不到任何警告或報錯，造成資料在不知不覺中遺失；現在系統會在最前端直接攔截並主動報錯，明確告知訊息過大無法送達，讓你能提早拆分或縮短內容。⟦像寄信時附檔超過信箱限制，按下送出前便會收到拒絕通知，不會表面寄出後又悄悄遺失。⟧
body.en: `SendMessage` now explicitly rejects oversized messages before delivery rather than dropping them into the void. Previously, when sending data across different sessions, messages exceeding the cross-session payload limit were silently discarded without any warning or error, leaving developers wondering where the message went. The system now validates size constraints up front and immediately returns a refusal error so you can trim or chunk the content. ⟦Like an email client warning that an attachment is too large before you press Send, rather than appearing to send it and then silently losing it.⟧

items.original: `SendMessage` now refuses messages too large for cross-session delivery up front instead of silently dropping them

title.zh-TW: 背景雲端審查資源消耗最佳化，不再重複掃描歷史事件串流
title.en: Background cloud sessions optimize CPU and memory by halting full stream re-renders

body.zh-TW: 當你在背景執行 `/ultrareview` 或 `/autofix-pr` 等雲端工作階段（session）時，記憶體與 CPU 使用量已改善。以往背景任務只要收到任何進度更新，系統就會把累積的事件串流從頭重新掃描並重新渲染一次；現在不再這樣做。⟦觀察遠方工廠的即時日誌時，每進來一筆新紀錄，記錄員只需把新的一行貼上，不必每次都把整本歷史日誌從頭到尾重讀並重畫一遍。⟧
body.en: Running cloud sessions like `/ultrareview` or `/autofix-pr` in the background now uses memory and CPU more efficiently. Previously, whenever a background cloud session updated, its entire event stream was re-scanned and re-rendered from scratch. That no longer happens on every update. ⟦Like a warehouse clerk jotting down incoming deliveries by simply appending a new line to the clipboard, rather than re-reading and redrawing the entire historical ledger on every single tick.⟧

items.original: Improved memory and CPU usage while cloud sessions such as `/ultrareview` or `/autofix-pr` run in the background — their event streams are no longer re-scanned and re-rendered on every update

title.zh-TW: 內建搜尋提升極端樣式防護，限制筆數時精準擷取前後文
title.en: Embedded grep handles pathological patterns safely and fixes context lines for -m N

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 與 Linux 原生版本中使用內建搜尋，遇到病態比對樣式時現在會立即中止，不再把記憶體吃到乾涸。內建的 `grep` 搜尋工具迎來兩項重要改進：首先是遇到病態比對樣式時，系統會迅速判定失敗並中斷，避免耗盡系統記憶體；其次是當你搭配 `-m N` 限制匹配次數，並使用 `-A` 或 `-C` 抓取周圍上下文時，輸出的前後行數現在完全正確。⟦就像試算表遇到無法處理的公式會先停止，不讓它吃光記憶體；需要相鄰儲存格時，也會精準顯示指定範圍。⟧
body.en: The embedded `grep` tool in native macOS and Linux builds is now much safer and more accurate. When encountering pathological search patterns, `grep` now fails fast instead of exhausting system memory. Furthermore, combining `-m N` (maximum match count) with `-A` (after context) or `-C` (surrounding context) flags now prints the exact required context lines without dropping or duplicating them. ⟦Like a spreadsheet that stops an unworkable formula before it consumes all memory, while showing exactly the requested neighboring cells.⟧

items.original: Improved the embedded `grep` in native macOS/Linux builds: pathological patterns now fail fast instead of exhausting memory, and `-m N` with `-A/-C` prints correct context

title.zh-TW: 對話長度觸及上限時，主動提示前往設定重新開啟自動壓縮
title.en: Context limit error guides users to /config when auto-compact is disabled

body.zh-TW: 當對話長度觸及上下文上限，而你關閉了自動壓縮功能時，現在會看見明確的提示。以前如果使用者關閉了對話自動壓縮（auto-compact），一旦上下文長度達到上限，系統只會拋出冷冰冰的上下文上限錯誤，讓人摸不著頭緒；現在錯誤訊息會主動說明當前已停用自動壓縮，並明確指引你輸入 `/config` 指令前往設定介面將它重新開啟。⟦如同行李箱裝滿時，拉鍊卡住的警示牌若能指引你開啟壓縮功能，就能省下倒出物品重新打包的麻煩。⟧
body.en: The context-limit error message now gives actionable advice when auto-compact is disabled. Previously, when conversations ran out of context window space with auto-compact turned off, the error gave no hint as to why compacting didn't happen. The system now explicitly warns you that auto-compact is off and directs you to run `/config` to turn it back on. ⟦Like a piece of luggage alerting you that its built-in vacuum compression valve is switched off before declaring that it cannot fit another shirt.⟧

items.original: Improved the context-limit error to say when auto-compact is off and point to `/config` to re-enable it

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式狀態妥善保留，切換逐字稿或關閉面板不丟失游標
title.en: Vim mode preserves NORMAL mode and cursor position across transcripts and panels

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用 Vim 模式編輯的開發者，按下 `ctrl+o` 查看詳細對話紀錄或關閉側邊面板後，NORMAL 模式與游標位置都會原封不動保留下來。在過去的版本中，只要你在終端機中切換完整逐字稿檢視（按 `ctrl+o` 開啟或關閉），或者關閉任何彈出面板，系統就會重設 Vim 的狀態，導致游標跑位或跳出 NORMAL 模式，打斷編輯節奏；現在切換檢視後狀態會完整保留，讓你流暢地繼續輸入。⟦彷彿在看書時抬頭查看附錄或關閉側邊筆記欄，視線與書籤依然精準停留在原本讀到的那一行文字上。⟧
body.en: Vim mode now reliably preserves NORMAL mode and your exact cursor position across UI toggles. Previously, pressing `ctrl+o` to toggle the detailed conversation transcript or closing an open panel would reset your Vim mode state and lose your cursor placement. The editor now remembers your active NORMAL mode state and cursor coordinates throughout these view transitions. ⟦Like looking up an appendix note or closing a sidebar on an e-reader while your reading cursor and bookmark stay locked precisely onto the sentence you were reading.⟧

items.original: Vim mode: NORMAL mode and cursor position are now preserved when toggling the detailed transcript (ctrl+o) or closing a panel

title.zh-TW: 重連未結工作階段時，展開的任務清單維持開啟狀態
title.en: Expanded task list (ctrl+t) stays open when resuming sessions with unfinished tasks

body.zh-TW: 重新連回仍有未結任務的工作階段（session）時，按 `ctrl+t` 展開的任務清單不會再強制收合。在以往的版本中，即使當前工作階段還有未完成的任務，每當你重新連線或重新啟動進入該工作階段時，展開的任務清單總是會預設縮回摺疊狀態；現在系統會記住展開狀態，讓你一開工就能立即掌握所有進行中的任務進度。⟦回到辦公桌重新開工時，只要手頭還有未完成的待辦事項，展開的白板便會維持攤開狀態，不必每次走進辦公室都得親手再拉開一次。⟧
body.en: The expanded task list (`ctrl+t`) no longer collapses on session restart if you still have active tasks. Previously, whenever you resumed or relaunched a session with unfinished tasks, the task list UI always defaulted to a collapsed state. It now properly starts expanded so you immediately see the status of all pending items upon resumption. ⟦Like returning to your desk to find the active task whiteboard still wide open, rather than having to manually unfold it every single time you walk into the room.⟧

items.original: Fixed the expanded task list (`ctrl+t`) always starting collapsed when resuming or relaunching into a session that still has open tasks

title.zh-TW: 背景更新完成後，提示頁尾即時顯示重新啟動通知
title.en: Prompt footer reliably shows update restart notices after background installs

body.zh-TW: 背景自動更新完成後，提示詞底部的狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在會老老實實秀出提示，提醒你重新啟動程式以套用新版。過去當 Claude Code 在背景默默下載並安裝好新版本時，最底部的提示頁尾往往漏掉顯示「Update installed」（更新已安裝）的重啟通知，導致使用者完全不知道背後已經升級、依然繼續跑著舊版；現在通知會如實出現，讓你能即時重啟換上最新版。⟦就像門市更換新招牌後，門口收銀台底下會及時亮起「新裝潢已就緒，重開門即可生效」的提示燈，不再默默完工卻不聲不響。⟧
body.en: The prompt footer now reliably shows the "Update installed" restart banner after background auto-updates. Previously, when an update finished installing quietly in the background, the footer notice failed to pop up, leaving you in the dark that a restart was needed to activate the new version. The notification now appears as expected so you know exactly when to restart and enjoy the latest release. ⟦Like a retail store finishing a store refresh and lighting up a "Renovations Complete — Please Re-enter" sign at the register, instead of wrapping up in silence.⟧

items.original: Fixed the prompt footer not showing the "Update installed" restart notice after a background auto-update

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制指令拉齊檢查標準，啟動時檢驗企業閘道器（enterprise gateway，企業網路的出入口）
title.en: Remote Control claude rc applies enterprise gateway checks consistently at startup

body.zh-TW: 透過 `claude rc` 啟動遠端控制時，現在會像一般互動式啟動一樣，在第一時間確實檢查企業閘道器是否可用。在企業資安環境中，互動式啟動 Claude Code 時原本就會嚴格檢驗閘道器連線狀態；然而過去使用遠端控制指令 `claude rc` 啟動時卻遺漏了這層檢查，容易引發連線異常。現在兩者的啟動檢驗標準完全拉齊，讓遠端連線同樣具備企業級的穩定度。⟦不論在洗衣機面板按下啟動，還是用手機遠端啟動，洗衣機現在都會先確認供水是否可用。⟧
body.en: Launching Remote Control via `claude rc` now performs the exact same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup. In corporate environments, standard interactive sessions verify gateway accessibility right at startup, but `claude rc` previously skipped this step, leading to inconsistent behavior. The check is now unified across both entry points to ensure reliable connectivity under enterprise policies. ⟦Whether you press Start on the washing machine or start it remotely from your phone, it first checks that the water supply is available.⟧

items.original: Remote Control: `claude rc` now applies the same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup

title.zh-TW: VS Code 面板焦點維持穩定，視窗重載不再隨機跳轉分頁
title.en: VS Code extension stops erratic tab jumping during window reloads and restores

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡開啟多個 Claude 面板時，重新載入或還原視窗，焦點不再於各分頁之間胡亂跳動。以往在同一個視窗中若開了多個 Claude 面板分頁，當視窗重新載入（reload）或從背景還原時，編輯器焦點會在各個分頁之間自己亂跳，打斷工作思路；現在分頁焦點在視窗重載後會穩定留在原處，避免視窗切換帶來的困擾。⟦瀏覽器重新開啟多個分頁時，焦點若能穩穩停在最後操作的分頁上，就不必在各分頁之間手動切換找回視線。⟧
body.en: VS Code users with multiple Claude panels open will no longer experience phantom focus jumping when reloading or restoring windows. Previously, restoring a workspace containing several Claude tabs caused the cursor focus to spontaneously hop between tabs on its own. Focus is now cleanly preserved upon window reloads. ⟦Like reopening a browser window with multiple tabs and having your focus stay locked onto the active tab you were actually reading, instead of flickering erratically between them.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed focus jumping between open Claude tabs on its own when a window with several Claude panels is restored or reloaded

entries: Added the optional `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory
Added the `selection:clear` keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view
Added a GitLab merge request badge to the footer and statusline: repos with a GitLab remote and an authenticated glab CLI show MR !N with draft/pending/green states
Claude Code now continues your session automatically when a claude.ai usage limit resets; turn it off in `/config` ("Continue automatically at usage limit")
Claude is now told to use your account email only to identify you, and not to send it to unrelated services unless you ask

Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (`\??\`) paths, hardening the remaining pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector
Fixed auto mode in very long sessions repeatedly re-checking and denying sandboxed commands' network access after the conversation had been compacted
Fixed session-scoped permission answers (including denies) being dropped when answering background subagent tool permission prompts
Fixed a crash when an API response on the non-streaming fallback path (typically via third-party gateways) contained a thinking block missing its thinking field or a text block missing its text field
Fixed markdown rendering becoming extremely slow for some messages containing unusual Unicode sequences
Fixed `SendMessage` rejecting a recipient copied from `ListAgents` when the session name is at the 200-character cap or emoji-heavy
Fixed repository detection mis-reading the host of git remotes with unusual userinfo, producing links and repo-specific behavior for the wrong host
Fixed MCP diagnostics printing resolved secrets: scope-conflict warnings now show the configured `${VAR}` form, and connection-failure details show only the server origin
Fixed `strictKnownMarketplaces` allowlists accepting SCP-style git marketplace sources whose host differs from the one git would actually connect to
Fixed modal text such as the `/login` OAuth URL losing characters when copied in fullscreen
Fixed a `---` horizontal rule in rendered markdown running into the line after it
Fixed consecutive shell commands splitting into multiple "Ran 1 shell command" rows when todo/task updates were interleaved between them
Fixed dialogs like `/permissions` opened while a `!` shell command was running being dismissed when the command finished
Fixed a queued `!` shell command being sent to the model as plain text after pressing up-arrow to edit the queued input
Fixed queued messages reappearing in the prompt history while still queued, Esc while selecting a queued message no longer interrupts the turn, and `!` mode no longer sticks after a mid-turn submit
Fixed accepting the "Try the new fullscreen renderer?" prompt restarting the session without its permission mode (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions`), tool allow/deny rules, model or effort flags
Fixed `/tui` dropping launch `--allowed-tools`/`--disallowed-tools` rules when it restarts; it now declines to switch, with the reason, when the session has restrictions a restart can't carry over
Fixed trust prompts omitting the repository-wide scope warning when the directory was first seen before the repository existed there
Fixed a case where an IDE diff tab closing during a permission re-prompt could answer the new prompt with the previous input
Fixed: files sent to the user during Remote Control sessions hosted by Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now upload, so they open on phone and web instead of showing an empty card
Fixed: after `/login` while `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is set, the stale-token reminder no longer leaks into Claude's automatically resumed turn — it now appears only to you
Fixed: permission previews now relay only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate, and a server's explicit permission-capability opt-out is honored
Fixed: credential masking on relayed permission previews can no longer hide commands, paths, or destinations from the approver; oversized private-key blocks now redact under full-strength redaction
Fixed: provider API tokens that mask on permission previews now mask even when directly followed by shell delimiters
Fixed Claude Desktop inter-session messages being silently dropped by the recipient session when cross-session messaging read as disabled, which left the sender's query "thinking" for many minutes
Remote Control: signing this computer in to a different claude.ai account or organization now stops the running session within seconds and says why, instead of a misleading HTTP 404 hours later
Remote Control sessions started from Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now keep phones and claude.ai/code updated on the session's permission mode (and claude.ai/code on the model) as they change
Remote Control: effort picks made on a phone or on claude.ai/code now apply to terminal- and Desktop/VS Code-hosted sessions, and the session publishes its effort level to connected clients
`SendMessage` and `ListAgents` now say when your account's session list was too long to check completely, instead of treating unseen sessions as absent
Expired Anthropic profile credential now points you at `/login` when a claude.ai login would take precedence
Improved the transcript: your own prompts now render markdown (highlighted code blocks, inline code, lists) the same way replies do
Improved the "API returned an empty or malformed response" error to say what came back (content type, body kind, size, request ID) and why the original streaming request failed
Improved auto-generated session titles to read as short, specific names (e.g. "Login button bug") rather than sentences restating your request (e.g. "Fix the login button on mobile")
Reduced the context cost of loading the built-in `claude-api` skill from ~200k+ tokens to ~25k by loading reference docs on demand
`/permissions` can now be opened while Claude is working — rule changes apply to the rest of the current turn
`/add-dir <path>` can now be used while Claude is working; `/add-dir`, `/autocompact`, `/theme`, `/help`, `/config` and `/advisor` dialogs open mid-turn in the fullscreen TUI
`/goal` now clears itself with a notice when a turn dies on an unrecoverable error (e.g. revoked auth, an exhausted credit balance, or a context overflow) instead of staying armed
`/goal`: when background tasks keep a goal waiting for 30+ minutes, Claude now checks in on them instead of waiting indefinitely (set `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` to opt out)
`claude setup-token` now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them
Changed Esc in fullscreen mode to no longer clear a mouse text selection: it interrupts or dismisses as usual and the selection stays highlighted
Removed the redundant "Allowed by auto mode classifier" line that auto mode showed under every Agent tool call
Removed the "Default teammate model" setting from `/config`; agent-team teammates now use the leader's model unless the spawn names one
Dimmed the elapsed-time counter on the running tool header so it no longer competes with the bold counts
Background task notifications delivered between turns are now sent to the model inside `<system-reminder>` tags, matching mid-turn delivery
Mantle: skip the admin-pin availability probe at startup when a main-loop model is already picked
Windows: startup no longer stalls on repeated rename retries when `~/.claude.json` is read-only

body.zh-TW: ⟦像檔案館替各專案卷宗編短檔號，櫃位仍在原處，翻找時不用讀完整串名稱。⟧同一台主機替每個工作階段各放一個設定資料夾時，對話紀錄的專案資料夾名稱不必再拖得很長。新增的環境變數（environment variable，程式啟動時讀取的外部設定）`CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` 可替每個專案的 transcript 資料夾指定短名。在啟動 Claude Code 的主機環境設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME=project-a`，讓專案 transcript 資料夾使用 `project-a`。原本分開存放的設定方式不變，只是資料夾名稱更好辨認。
body.en: ⟦It is like an archive giving each project file a short reference code while leaving it on the same shelf.⟧Hosts that give each session its own config directory can set `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` to choose a short per-project transcript directory name. On the host that starts Claude Code, set `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME=project-a` so the project's transcript directory uses `project-a`.

items.original: Added the optional `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory

title.zh-TW: 替每個專案的對話紀錄取短名
title.en: Short names for project transcripts

body.zh-TW: ⟦這像桌上多了一把只用來擦掉螢光筆記號的橡皮擦，而離開按鈕不會順手把整段標記抹掉。⟧在程式裡反白一段文字後，現在可把按鍵綁定到 `selection:clear`，專門取消這個文字選取；agents view 也能用。全螢幕模式用滑鼠反白時，Esc 則不會再把選取範圍清掉，它照常只負責中斷或關閉。你可以在按鍵設定中把 `selection:clear` 指給想用的按鍵。
body.en: ⟦It is a dedicated eraser, not an exit button that wipes your highlight.⟧Bind a key to `selection:clear` to clear an in-app text selection, including in agents view. In fullscreen, Esc keeps a mouse selection highlighted while still interrupting or dismissing.

title.zh-TW: 選取文字可用按鍵清掉，Esc 不再誤清
title.en: Clear selections deliberately

body.zh-TW: ⟦像球場計分板隨時亮出比賽狀態，不必離場另外查詢。⟧專案連到 GitLab，而且 `glab` CLI 已完成登入時，頁尾與狀態列（statusline，終端機最底下的即時資訊）會顯示合併請求的 `MR !N`。草稿、等待中與綠色狀態也會一起顯示，不必先離開目前工作去查網頁。這只適用於有 GitLab remote 的 repository，並需要已驗證的 `glab`。
body.en: ⟦It is like a stadium scoreboard showing a match’s state as it changes.⟧Repositories with a GitLab remote and authenticated `glab` now show MR !N and draft, pending, or green status in the footer and statusline.

items.original: Added a GitLab merge request badge to the footer and statusline: repos with a GitLab remote and an authenticated glab CLI show MR !N with draft/pending/green states

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求狀態直接顯示
title.en: GitLab merge-request status at a glance

body.zh-TW: ⟦像暫停的播放器在可播放時接著播；不想它自動播放，就把那個選項關掉。⟧工作做到 claude.ai 用量限制剛好卡住時，額度重設後，Claude Code 現在會自動延續原本的工作階段。若你不想自動繼續，可開 `/config`，關掉「Continue automatically at usage limit」。選擇權留在你手上：保留設定就等待額度重設後接續，關閉後則由你決定何時再開始。
body.en: ⟦It is like resuming a paused player when playback becomes available.⟧Claude Code can now continue your session when a claude.ai usage limit resets. Turn it off in `/config` under “Continue automatically at usage limit.”

items.original: Claude Code now continues your session automatically when a claude.ai usage limit resets; turn it off in `/config` ("Continue automatically at usage limit")

title.zh-TW: 用量額度重設後可自動接著工作
title.en: Resume when a usage limit resets

body.zh-TW: ⟦像櫃檯核對證件後把證件還給你，不會拿著它去別的店家登記。⟧帳號 email 現在被明確限制為辨識你本人之用。除非你提出要求，Claude 不會把它送往無關的服務。這講的是帳號信箱的使用界線，不是要你另外開啟某個設定；當對話需要知道你是誰時可使用，和外部不相干服務之間則不自行傳遞，也不會因為系統自行選擇而交給外部；這正是它的限制。
body.en: ⟦It is like a clerk checking an ID and handing it back.⟧Claude is instructed to use your account email only to identify you, and not send it to unrelated services unless you ask.

items.original: Claude is now told to use your account email only to identify you, and not to send it to unrelated services unless you ask

title.zh-TW: 帳號信箱只用來辨識你
title.en: Your account email stays for identification

body.zh-TW: ⟦像行李分揀系統先剔除標籤格式異常的行李，不讓它進入後續運送流程。⟧遠端讀檔、還原工作階段、載入 CLAUDE.md、workflow script 與上傳檔案，現在都拒絕 Windows NT-namespace 的 `\??\` 路徑。這些原本仍在核准前可進行的檔案存取點，因此特別補上防線，用來降低 NTLM credential leak 的風險。它不是一般檔案路徑都不能讀，而是針對這種特殊命名空間格式。
body.en: ⟦It is like a baggage-sorting system removing luggage with a malformed tag before it enters the delivery line.⟧Remote reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts, and uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace `\??\` paths, hardening remaining pre-approval access against NTLM credential leaks.

items.original: Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (`\??\`) paths, hardening the remaining pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector

title.zh-TW: Windows 特殊路徑在核准前先擋下
title.en: Block risky Windows namespace paths early

body.zh-TW: ⟦像長途接力時把已蓋章的通行單一路傳下去，不會跑到中途又要求同一張單重新審核。⟧很長的對話被 compact 之後，auto mode 不會再反覆重查並拒絕 sandboxed command 的網路存取。背景 subagent 跳出工具權限詢問時，這個工作階段的允許或拒絕回答也不會再遺失。前者處理對話壓縮後的網路權限，後者保住你對背景代理的選擇。
body.en: ⟦It is like passing the stamped pass along a relay.⟧After a long conversation is compacted, auto mode no longer repeatedly rechecks and denies sandboxed commands’ network access. Session-scoped allow and deny answers also persist for background subagent permission prompts.

items.original:
Fixed auto mode in very long sessions repeatedly re-checking and denying sandboxed commands' network access after the conversation had been compacted
Fixed session-scoped permission answers (including denies) being dropped when answering background subagent tool permission prompts

title.zh-TW: 長對話裡的權限回答不再失憶
title.en: Permissions stay put in long sessions

body.zh-TW: ⟦像實驗儀器標出缺少的讀值，卻不讓整場測試停擺，還會留下可追查的紀錄。⟧經由第三方 gateway 的非串流備援回應，若 thinking block 少了 thinking 欄位，或 text block 少了 text 欄位，Claude Code 不再因此當機。碰上「API returned an empty or malformed response」時，錯誤訊息也會交代收到的 content type、body kind、size、request ID，以及原本 streaming request 為何失敗。
body.en: ⟦It is like a lab instrument flagging incomplete readings without stopping the whole test.⟧A non-streaming fallback response with a missing thinking or text field no longer crashes Claude Code. Empty or malformed API errors now report content type, body kind, size, request ID, and why streaming failed.

items.original:
Fixed a crash when an API response on the non-streaming fallback path (typically via third-party gateways) contained a thinking block missing its thinking field or a text block missing its text field
Improved the "API returned an empty or malformed response" error to say what came back (content type, body kind, size, request ID) and why the original streaming request failed

title.zh-TW: 異常 API 回應不再直接當機，錯誤更好查
title.en: API response failures no longer fail silently

body.zh-TW: ⟦像排版員把一頁講義的分隔線、特殊字元和手寫筆記一併排正，讀起來不再卡住或擠成一團。⟧少見 Unicode 字元序列的訊息不會再讓 markdown rendering 慢到難以使用，`---` horizontal rule 也不再黏到下一行。你自己輸入的 prompt 現在同樣會用 markdown 顯示，包含 highlighted code block、inline code 與 list，和回覆的呈現方式一致。這些改動都在整理對話文字如何被畫出來。
body.en: ⟦It is like a typesetter aligning special characters, rules, and notes together.⟧Unusual Unicode sequences no longer make markdown rendering extremely slow, and `---` no longer runs into the next line. Your prompts now render markdown like replies, including code blocks, inline code, and lists.

items.original:
Fixed markdown rendering becoming extremely slow for some messages containing unusual Unicode sequences
Fixed a `---` horizontal rule in rendered markdown running into the line after it
Improved the transcript: your own prompts now render markdown (highlighted code blocks, inline code, lists) the same way replies do

title.zh-TW: Markdown 顯示更快，也更像對話內容
title.en: Markdown renders cleanly and consistently

body.zh-TW: 從 `ListAgents` 複製 recipient 後，即使 session name 剛好到 200-character cap，或塞了很多 emoji，`SendMessage` 也不會再拒收。帳號的 session list 太長而無法完整檢查時，`SendMessage` 和 `ListAgents` 現在會明說，不能再把沒看見的工作階段當成不存在。⟦像圖書館員查閱很長的索引，既能依完整條目找書，也會標出尚未核對的卷冊。⟧
body.en: `SendMessage` accepts recipients copied from `ListAgents` even at the 200-character session-name cap or with many emoji. Both commands now say when the session list was too long to check completely. ⟦It is like a librarian using a long catalogue entry while marking the volumes not yet checked.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `SendMessage` rejecting a recipient copied from `ListAgents` when the session name is at the 200-character cap or emoji-heavy
`SendMessage` and `ListAgents` now say when your account's session list was too long to check completely, instead of treating unseen sessions as absent

title.zh-TW: 代理訊息與清單不再把長名稱看錯
title.en: Agent messaging handles long session lists

body.zh-TW: git remote 的網址帶有特殊 userinfo 時，repository detection 過去可能讀錯 host，讓連結指向錯誤主機，也讓依 repository 而定的行為套用到不對的地方。現在它會抓到正確的 host，連結與依 repository 區分的行為也回到該去的位置。⟦像導航讀到地址中的特殊註記時，仍能辨認目的地，不會把註記當成城市。⟧
body.en: Repository detection now reads unusual git-remote userinfo without choosing the wrong host, so links and repository-specific behavior use the right host. ⟦It is like navigation recognizing the real destination despite an unusual note in the address.⟧

items.original: Fixed repository detection mis-reading the host of git remotes with unusual userinfo, producing links and repo-specific behavior for the wrong host

title.zh-TW: Git remote 會辨識正確主機
title.en: Git remote detection finds the right host

body.zh-TW: 檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）diagnostic 時，畫面不再印出已解析的 secret。scope conflict warning 會保留設定中的 `${VAR}` 形式；connection failure detail 則只顯示 server origin。⟦像檢驗報告保留欄位名稱與檢體來源，卻不把檢體內容攤在走廊給人看。⟧
body.en: MCP diagnostics no longer print resolved secrets: scope-conflict warnings show configured `${VAR}`, and connection-failure details show only the server origin. ⟦It is like a medical report retaining the field names and specimen origin without exposing the sample itself.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP diagnostics printing resolved secrets: scope-conflict warnings now show the configured `${VAR}` form, and connection-failure details show only the server origin

title.zh-TW: MCP 診斷不再露出機密
title.en: MCP diagnostics keep secrets out of view

body.zh-TW: `strictKnownMarketplaces` 的 allowlist 現在不會接受一個看似允許、但 Git 實際連線主機不同的 SCP-style git marketplace source。這是修正來源檢查與真正連線位置不一致的問題；設定了嚴格白名單時，檢查對象會對準 Git 真正要連去的 host。⟦像航空管制核對飛機實際使用的呼號是否在許可名單上，而不只看飛行計畫表的名稱。⟧
body.en: `strictKnownMarketplaces` allowlists no longer accept an SCP-style Git marketplace source whose host differs from where Git will actually connect. ⟦It is like air traffic control checking an aircraft's actual call sign against an approved list, not only the name on its flight plan.⟧

items.original: Fixed `strictKnownMarketplaces` allowlists accepting SCP-style git marketplace sources whose host differs from the one git would actually connect to

title.zh-TW: 市集來源白名單會核對真正連線主機
title.en: Marketplace allowlists check the real Git host

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕複製 `/login` 的 OAuth URL 等 modal 文字時，不會再遺失字元。當 Anthropic profile credential 已過期，且 claude.ai login 會優先處理時，畫面會指向 `/login`。若 `/login` 後仍設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`，舊 token 的提醒只會給你看，不會漏進 Claude 自動延續的 turn。⟦像自助入口螢幕給你完整通行碼，把過期憑證帶到正確的登入入口，提醒只留在你的螢幕上。⟧
body.en: Fullscreen copying keeps all characters in modal text such as a `/login` OAuth URL. Expired profile credentials point to `/login` when a claude.ai login would take precedence, and stale `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` reminders appear only to you, not Claude’s resumed turn. ⟦It is like a self-service entry screen giving you the complete code, directing an expired credential to the right login, and keeping the reminder on your screen.⟧

items.original:
Fixed modal text such as the `/login` OAuth URL losing characters when copied in fullscreen
Fixed: after `/login` while `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is set, the stale-token reminder no longer leaks into Claude's automatically resumed turn — it now appears only to you
Expired Anthropic profile credential now points you at `/login` when a claude.ai login would take precedence

title.zh-TW: 登入連結與登入提醒各自送到對的人
title.en: Login links and reminders reach the right place

body.zh-TW: Claude 正在工作時，`/permissions` 的規則修改會套用到目前 turn 的剩餘部分；`/add-dir <path>` 也能使用。全螢幕 TUI 中，`/add-dir`、`/autocompact`、`/theme`、`/help`、`/config`、`/advisor` 可在中途開啟。正在跑 `!` shell command 時開 `/permissions` 等 dialog 不會在指令結束後被關掉；佇列中的 `!` 指令經上箭頭編輯，也不會被當 plain text 送給 model。⟦像直播導播台在播出中仍能調整設定，排隊片段也不會被當成旁白播出。⟧
body.en: While Claude works, `/permissions` changes apply to the rest of the turn and `/add-dir <path>` works. Fullscreen TUI dialogs can open mid-turn; dialogs survive a running `!` command, and edited queued `!` commands stay shell commands. ⟦It is like a live control room changing settings during a broadcast without turning queued clips into narration.⟧

items.original:
Fixed dialogs like `/permissions` opened while a `!` shell command was running being dismissed when the command finished
Fixed a queued `!` shell command being sent to the model as plain text after pressing up-arrow to edit the queued input
`/permissions` can now be opened while Claude is working — rule changes apply to the rest of the current turn
`/add-dir <path>` can now be used while Claude is working; `/add-dir`, `/autocompact`, `/theme`, `/help`, `/config` and `/advisor` dialogs open mid-turn in the fullscreen TUI

title.zh-TW: 執行中仍可開設定對話，佇列指令也不走樣
title.en: Mid-turn controls and queued shell commands behave

body.zh-TW: 還在 queued 的訊息不會再提早重現於 prompt history。選取 queued message 時按 Esc，現在不會中斷目前 turn；在中途送出後，`!` mode 也不會殘留黏住。這三項都在分清楚「尚未送出」和「已送去執行」的界線，避免操作佇列時干擾正在進行的工作。⟦像餐廳叫號單仍掛在等候板時，不會先跑進已完成紀錄，也不會把取消鈴誤當成叫停整間廚房。⟧
body.en: Queued messages no longer reappear in prompt history while queued; Esc on a selected queued message does not interrupt the turn, and `!` mode no longer sticks after a mid-turn submit. ⟦It is like keeping a waiting ticket on the board until it is served.⟧

items.original: Fixed queued messages reappearing in the prompt history while still queued, Esc while selecting a queued message no longer interrupts the turn, and `!` mode no longer sticks after a mid-turn submit

title.zh-TW: 佇列訊息不再搶進歷史，也不黏住 shell 模式
title.en: Queued input stays queued

body.zh-TW: 新的 fullscreen renderer 提示被接受後重啟 session 時，permission mode、tool allow/deny rule、model 與 effort flag 不會再遺失。`/tui` 若發現目前 session 有它無法帶過重啟的 `--allowed-tools` 或 `--disallowed-tools` restriction，現在會拒絕切換並說明原因。它不再假裝重啟後還保有其實帶不走的限制。⟦像搬家交接清單，確認受限制物品也能完整帶走才換房；帶不走時，交接人會先說明不能搬。⟧
body.en: Restarting after “Try the new fullscreen renderer?” preserves permission mode, tool rules, model, and effort flags. `/tui` declines a switch when it cannot carry `--allowed-tools` or `--disallowed-tools` restrictions through restart. ⟦It is like a moving inventory that switches rooms only after every restricted item can be handed over.⟧

items.original:
Fixed accepting the "Try the new fullscreen renderer?" prompt restarting the session without its permission mode (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions`), tool allow/deny rules, model or effort flags
Fixed `/tui` dropping launch `--allowed-tools`/`--disallowed-tools` rules when it restarts; it now declines to switch, with the reason, when the session has restrictions a restart can't carry over

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕重啟不再遺失限制規則
title.en: Fullscreen restarts keep restrictions honest

body.zh-TW: 某個目錄先被看見、後來才在那裡出現 repository 時，trust prompt 現在會帶出 repository-wide scope warning。IDE 的 diff tab 剛好在 permission re-prompt 期間關閉，也不會把上一題的 input 套給新題目。前者補回你該知道的信任範圍，後者確保每次提問只收自己的回答。⟦像簽核表補上整份合約適用範圍，並在換一張表單時不把上一張的簽名誤蓋過去。⟧
body.en: Trust prompts now include the repository-wide scope warning when a repository appeared after its directory was first seen. Closing an IDE diff tab during a re-prompt no longer applies the previous input to the new prompt. ⟦It is like adding the contract scope and never copying an old signature to a new form.⟧

items.original:
Fixed trust prompts omitting the repository-wide scope warning when the directory was first seen before the repository existed there
Fixed a case where an IDE diff tab closing during a permission re-prompt could answer the new prompt with the previous input

title.zh-TW: 權限提問會對準正確範圍與正確回答
title.en: Permission prompts keep their scope and answer

body.zh-TW: Claude Code Desktop 或 VS Code 主持的 Remote Control session 傳給使用者的檔案，現在會 upload，因此在 phone 和 web 開啟時不再只看到 empty card。這台電腦登入不同 claude.ai account 或 organization 時，正在執行的 session 會在幾秒內停止並說明原因，不再拖到 HTTP 404。permission mode 的改變會同步給 phone 和 claude.ai/code，後者也會收到 model；phone 或 claude.ai/code 選的 effort 會套用到 terminal、Desktop、VS Code 主持的 session，並發布給連線 client。⟦像遠端會議室把檔案送到每位與會者手中；換了門禁身分就結束舊會議，螢幕同步顯示規則。⟧
body.en: Remote Control files from Desktop or VS Code now upload for phone and web. Signing this computer into another account or organization stops the session within seconds with a reason. Sessions hosted by Desktop or VS Code send permission-mode updates to phone and claude.ai/code, and model updates to claude.ai/code. Effort chosen on a phone or claude.ai/code applies to terminal and Desktop/VS Code-hosted sessions; the session also publishes its effort level to connected clients. ⟦It is like a remote meeting that actually hands out the file and updates every screen’s rules.⟧

items.original:
Fixed: files sent to the user during Remote Control sessions hosted by Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now upload, so they open on phone and web instead of showing an empty card
Remote Control: signing this computer in to a different claude.ai account or organization now stops the running session within seconds and says why, instead of a misleading HTTP 404 hours later
Remote Control sessions started from Claude Code Desktop or VS Code now keep phones and claude.ai/code updated on the session's permission mode (and claude.ai/code on the model) as they change
Remote Control: effort picks made on a phone or on claude.ai/code now apply to terminal- and Desktop/VS Code-hosted sessions, and the session publishes its effort level to connected clients

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制傳檔、切帳號與跨裝置資訊更可靠
title.en: Remote Control stays in sync and stops safely

body.zh-TW: permission preview 現在只 relay 給通過 inbound trust gate 的 channel server，也尊重 server 明確表示不提供 permission capability 的選擇。relay 時的 credential masking 不會再把 command、path 或 destination 一起遮掉，讓 approver 看不見該核准什麼；過大的 private-key block 則會用完整強度 redaction。provider API token 即使緊接 shell delimiter，也會被 mask。⟦像保全只把申請單交給已驗證的窗口，該遮住的密碼遮住，收件地址與申請內容卻仍讓核准者看清。⟧
body.en: Permission previews relay only to trusted channel servers and honor permission-capability opt-out. Masking no longer hides commands, paths, or destinations from approvers, while large private keys remain redacted and provider API tokens remain redacted even when immediately followed by shell delimiters. ⟦It is like giving a request to a verified desk with secrets covered but the approval details visible.⟧

items.original:
Fixed: permission previews now relay only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate, and a server's explicit permission-capability opt-out is honored
Fixed: credential masking on relayed permission previews can no longer hide commands, paths, or destinations from the approver; oversized private-key blocks now redact under full-strength redaction
Fixed: provider API tokens that mask on permission previews now mask even when directly followed by shell delimiters

title.zh-TW: 權限預覽既不外送也不遮住關鍵內容
title.en: Permission previews share less and show approvers enough

body.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 的 inter-session message 在接收端把 cross-session messaging 讀成 disabled 時，過去會被悄悄丟掉，送出端的 query 便長時間停在「thinking」。現在接收 session 不會再因為這個讀取錯誤而丟訊息。修的是訊息傳遞的錯誤判讀，讓送出端不會因為收件端其實沒收到而一直等待。⟦像電話總機不再把誤判為被攔截的通話直接掛斷，來電者也不用對著沒有回音的線路等候。⟧
body.en: Claude Desktop inter-session messages are no longer silently dropped when the recipient reads cross-session messaging as disabled, leaving the sender stuck “thinking.” ⟦It is like a telephone switchboard no longer disconnecting a call it misread as blocked.⟧

items.original: Fixed Claude Desktop inter-session messages being silently dropped by the recipient session when cross-session messaging read as disabled, which left the sender's query "thinking" for many minutes

title.zh-TW: Desktop 跨工作階段訊息不再悄悄遺失
title.en: Desktop cross-session messages arrive

body.zh-TW: 自動產生的 session title 現在偏向短而具體的名稱，例如「Login button bug」，不再只是把你的請求整句重述成「Fix the login button on mobile」。名稱仍是自動生成，但用途從重複一遍對話內容，改為替之後回看時提供更快辨識的標籤。⟦像電影院場次表只寫片名，不重播整段預告；短名讓你一眼認出要找的那場。⟧
body.en: Auto-generated session titles now favor short, specific names such as “Login button bug” instead of restating the request as a sentence. ⟦It is like a cinema schedule showing a film title, not replaying the whole trailer.⟧

items.original: Improved auto-generated session titles to read as short, specific names (e.g. "Login button bug") rather than sentences restating your request (e.g. "Fix the login button on mobile")

title.zh-TW: 自動產生的工作階段名稱更像標籤
title.en: Auto session titles become useful labels

body.zh-TW: 載入內建 `claude-api` skill 時，context cost 已從約 200k+ tokens 降到約 25k tokens。做法是 reference doc 改成按需要才載入，而不是一開始全塞進 context。token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）這裡指模型讀取文字所用的量；技能仍可用，只是先帶進對話的參考資料變少。⟦像出門先帶常用工具箱，等真的需要某份說明書才去抽取，而非把整個倉庫都搬上車。⟧
body.en: Loading the built-in `claude-api` skill now costs about 25k tokens instead of about 200k+ by loading reference docs on demand. ⟦It is like taking the toolbox first and fetching a manual only when needed.⟧

items.original: Reduced the context cost of loading the built-in `claude-api` skill from ~200k+ tokens to ~25k by loading reference docs on demand

title.zh-TW: 內建 claude-api 技能載入少花上下文
title.en: The built-in claude-api skill uses less context

body.zh-TW: turn 因 revoked auth、exhausted credit balance 或 context overflow 這類不可復原錯誤結束時，`/goal` 會自行清掉並通知你，不再保持 armed 狀態。background task 讓 goal 等了 30+ minutes 時，Claude 會去 check in，不再無限等待；若不想要這個動作，可設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0`。⟦像待辦清單發現任務已因無法修復的原因中止，就把它標示結束；等候太久的委託則主動問一次進度。⟧
body.en: `/goal` clears itself with notice after unrecoverable errors. When background tasks keep it waiting 30+ minutes, Claude checks in; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` to opt out. ⟦It is like closing an irrecoverably failed task and asking for progress on one that waits too long.⟧

items.original:
`/goal` now clears itself with a notice when a turn dies on an unrecoverable error (e.g. revoked auth, an exhausted credit balance, or a context overflow) instead of staying armed
`/goal`: when background tasks keep a goal waiting for 30+ minutes, Claude now checks in on them instead of waiting indefinitely (set `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` to opt out)

title.zh-TW: 目標遇到不可復原錯誤會清楚收尾，也會追問背景工作
title.en: Goals clear failed turns and check on waiting work

body.zh-TW: 執行 `claude setup-token` 時，預期之外的 extra argument 不會再被靜靜忽略，現在會直接拒絕。這可避免你以為多打的內容被採用，實際卻完全沒有作用；指令接受或拒絕的範圍會明白表現出來。要設定 token 時，請只輸入此命令預期的參數。⟦像門禁掃描器收到多出的一張卡，會當場報錯，不把它假裝算進通行紀錄。⟧
body.en: `claude setup-token` now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them. ⟦It is like an access-control scanner receiving an extra card: it flags the error immediately rather than pretending it belongs in the entry log.⟧

items.original: `claude setup-token` now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them

title.zh-TW: setup-token 多打一個參數也會被攔下
title.en: setup-token rejects stray arguments

body.zh-TW: auto mode 原本每個 Agent tool call 下方都重複顯示「Allowed by auto mode classifier」，這行現在移除了。正在執行的 tool header 裡，elapsed-time counter 也調暗，不再和粗體 count 搶視線。兩者都不是功能權限改變，而是把已經呈現的工具活動資訊整理得更不擁擠。⟦像儀表板拿掉每格都重複的核准貼紙，並把次要的時間字淡化，眼睛自然先看到真正需要注意的數字。⟧
body.en: Auto mode no longer repeats “Allowed by auto mode classifier” below every Agent tool call, and the running tool header dims its elapsed-time counter beside bold counts. ⟦It is like removing duplicate approval stickers and fading a secondary clock on a dashboard.⟧

items.original:
Removed the redundant "Allowed by auto mode classifier" line that auto mode showed under every Agent tool call
Dimmed the elapsed-time counter on the running tool header so it no longer competes with the bold counts

title.zh-TW: 工具畫面少掉重複標籤，重點更容易看
title.en: Tool activity has less visual noise

body.zh-TW: `/config` 裡的「Default teammate model」設定已移除。agent-team 的 teammate 現在會沿用 leader 的 model，只有在 spawn 時明確指定才會用另一個。這是既有選擇規則的調整，不是新增另一個預設模型。⟦像同一組樂團照指揮選定的曲譜演奏，只有開演前特別指派的樂手才拿不同版本。⟧
body.en: The `/config` “Default teammate model” setting is gone: agent-team teammates use the leader’s model unless spawn names one. ⟦It is like an orchestra using the conductor’s chosen score unless a player is assigned a different part before starting.⟧

items.original: Removed the "Default teammate model" setting from `/config`; agent-team teammates now use the leader's model unless the spawn names one

title.zh-TW: 代理團隊沿用領隊模型
title.en: Teams inherit the leader model

body.zh-TW: 背景工作在兩個 turn 之間送來 notification 時，model 現在會在 `<system-reminder>` tags 內收到，與 turn 中途送達的格式一致。這項調整統一通知的外框，讓不同時點送達的內容採用同一種標記。背景工作仍是在兩個 turn 之間送達；改的是 model 收到它時所看見的外層格式。⟦像舞台監督無論在演出中或換場時遞提示卡，都放進同樣的提示套。⟧
body.en: Between-turn background task notifications now reach the model inside `<system-reminder>` tags, matching mid-turn delivery. ⟦It is like a stage manager putting reminders in the same sleeve whether they arrive during a scene or between scenes.⟧

items.original: Background task notifications delivered between turns are now sent to the model inside `<system-reminder>` tags, matching mid-turn delivery

title.zh-TW: 背景通知沿用同一種標記格式
title.en: Background notifications use the usual tags

body.zh-TW: Mantle 啟動時，如果 main-loop model 已經選好，現在會略過 admin-pin availability probe。原本那個 probe 是在確認 admin-pin 是否可用；既然主迴圈模型已有選擇，這個條件下就不再進行該項啟動檢查。此項是縮減啟動流程裡不需要的探查，沒有新增一個管理 PIN 設定。⟦像出門前既然已拿到指定鑰匙，就不用再回頭逐一檢查另一串備用鑰匙。⟧
body.en: At startup, Mantle skips the admin-pin availability probe when a main-loop model is already selected. ⟦It is like not checking every spare key once you already have the required one.⟧

items.original: Mantle: skip the admin-pin availability probe at startup when a main-loop model is already picked

title.zh-TW: Mantle 啟動少做一次不必做的探查
title.en: Mantle skips an unnecessary startup probe

body.zh-TW: Windows 上的 `~/.claude.json` 若是 read-only，Claude Code 啟動時不會再卡在 repeated rename retry。問題出在反覆嘗試重新命名這個設定檔；現在遇到唯讀狀態時，啟動流程不會因此停滯。這不表示程式會改寫唯讀檔，而是避免無法改名時一直卡在重試。⟦像門鎖住的檔案櫃不能搬動時，工作人員不再一直拉著把手不放，而會讓其他開門準備繼續走。⟧
body.en: On Windows, startup no longer stalls on repeated rename retries when `~/.claude.json` is read-only. ⟦It is like not endlessly tugging a locked filing cabinet that cannot be moved.⟧

items.original: Windows: startup no longer stalls on repeated rename retries when `~/.claude.json` is read-only

title.zh-TW: 唯讀設定檔不再讓 Windows 啟動卡住
title.en: Read-only settings no longer stall Windows startup

body.zh-TW: 連續執行 shell command 時，如果中間穿插 todo 或 task update，畫面過去可能把同一串操作拆成多個「Ran 1 shell command」列。現在不會因為這些更新插進來，就把連續指令的執行紀錄切碎。todo 與 task 的更新仍會出現，只是不再改變你看到的 shell command 分組。⟦像會議紀錄裡插入待辦提醒後，仍把同一位講者連續說的話收在同一段，不會每插一張便條就另開一段。⟧
body.en: Consecutive shell commands no longer split into multiple “Ran 1 shell command” rows when todo or task updates occur between them. ⟦It is like keeping one speaker’s continuous remarks in one paragraph despite inserted notes.⟧

items.original: Fixed consecutive shell commands splitting into multiple "Ran 1 shell command" rows when todo/task updates were interleaved between them

title.zh-TW: 連續 shell 指令會合在正確的執行紀錄裡
title.en: Consecutive shell commands keep one accurate record

entries: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)
Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user
Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)
Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt
Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)
Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code
Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled
Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill
Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers
Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector
Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch
Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway
Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse
Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence
Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts

Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back
Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求可直接開工作樹
title.en: Open a worktree straight from a GitLab merge request

body.zh-TW: 同事丟來 GitLab 的合併請求網址時，現在可把網址交給 `--worktree`，也能在 `claude agents` 檢視裡直接辨認它。工作樹（worktree，Git 為同一專案開出的平行副本）讓你另開一份地方查看修改，不必離開手邊工作。⟦這像收到一張待辦房間的門牌；網址一貼，便能走進另一間房核對內容，而非先手抄房號。⟧ 合併請求會顯示成 `!N`，因此清單裡能看出它是 GitLab 的項目。
body.en: When a teammate sends a GitLab merge-request URL, you can now give that URL to `--worktree` and recognize it in the `claude agents` view. A worktree is a parallel copy of a Git project, so you can inspect changes somewhere separate from current work. ⟦It is like receiving a room number on a work order: paste the address and walk into that room, rather than copying its number first.⟧ Merge requests appear as `!N`, making their GitLab identity visible in the list.

items.original: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)

title.zh-TW: 閘道可把使用者身分交給後端記帳
title.en: Gateway can pass user identity to proxy accounting

body.zh-TW: 公司透過 apps gateway 連到 Anthropic 上游服務，又想知道費用算在誰身上時，可選擇開啟 `forward_user_identity`。這個設定會把已登入使用者的身分放進 headers（隨請求附上的資訊欄位）。再交給閘道後方代替你轉送請求的 proxy。⟦像包裹經過收發室時附上寄件人卡片，後方的記帳人便能把運費記到對的人名下。⟧ 此設定是選用項目；不開啟便不會轉送這份身分資訊。
body.en: If your company connects to Anthropic upstreams through an apps gateway and needs to assign spending to people, it can opt into `forward_user_identity`. This setting puts the signed-in user's identity into request headers for a proxy behind the gateway. ⟦It is like attaching a sender card to a parcel at the mailroom, so the accountant down the line can charge delivery to the right person.⟧ Leave it off and that identity is not forwarded.

items.original: Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user

title.zh-TW: Linux Bash 可替失控建置設記憶體上限
title.en: Linux Bash can cap memory for a runaway build

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 用 Bash 工具跑建置，若擔心失控的建置拖住工作階段，可選擇設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`。它會替 Bash 指令啟用 memory cgroup（替一組程式設下記憶體界線的 Linux 機制）。⟦像共用儲物間替一台攪拌機劃出固定容量；它的材料塞滿自己的格子後，不能再占用整間空間，其他人的東西仍放得下。⟧ 這是選用支援，目的是避免失控的建置讓整個工作階段停住。
body.en: When a build runs through the Bash tool on Linux, you can opt into `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT` if a runaway build might stall the session. It enables a memory cgroup, Linux's boundary for the memory available to a group of programs. ⟦It is like giving one mixer a fixed storage compartment: once its ingredients fill that compartment, they cannot take over the whole storeroom, and everyone else's things still fit.⟧ The optional limit keeps a runaway build from stalling the session.

items.original: Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session

title.zh-TW: WebFetch 網址快取保存時間可自行設定
title.en: Set WebFetch URL cache lifetime yourself

body.zh-TW: 同一個 WebFetch 工作階段裡，想調整網址快取保存多久，現在可設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS`。快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）會在工作階段內保存網址查詢結果；這個變數專門調整它的存活時間。⟦像替已查過的電話簿頁面貼上有效期限標籤，到期前可直接翻那頁，到期後才重新查號。⟧ 預設值仍是 15 分鐘，沒有因這項設定而改變。
body.en: Within one WebFetch session, you can now set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` to choose how long its URL cache lasts. A cache keeps a URL lookup result for direct reuse during the session; this variable controls that lifetime. ⟦It is like putting an expiry label on a phone-book page you already checked: use that page until it expires, then look up the number again.⟧ The default remains 15 minutes.

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)

title.zh-TW: 雲端關機等權限時，不再誤報遺失工作階段
title.en: Cloud shutdown during a permission wait no longer loses session

body.zh-TW: Claude 正等你回應權限提示，雲端環境卻在此時關閉，先前偶爾會把雲端工作階段標成遺失。這次修正針對的正是「等待權限」與「環境關閉」同時發生的情況，也不把環境關閉誤當成工作階段遺失的錯誤依據。⟦如同櫃檯正等你簽名，辦公室卻先熄燈；現在不會因此把你的案件判成不見了。⟧ 之後遇到這種順序，工作階段不會再被錯誤標記為 lost。
body.en: If Claude was waiting at a permission prompt and the cloud environment shut down, a cloud session could occasionally be marked as lost. This fix covers that exact overlap: waiting for permission while the environment closes. ⟦It is like a desk clerk waiting for your signature when the office lights go out; the case is no longer declared missing because of that.⟧ In that situation, the session is no longer wrongly marked lost.

items.original: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt

title.zh-TW: MCP 長連線遇逾時不再反覆重開
title.en: MCP long connections stop reopening after timeouts

body.zh-TW: 使用會在固定時間結束長連線的 serverless 主機時，MCP v2 連線先前可能不停重開 `subscriptions/listen` 串流。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）透過這條串流接收訂閱資訊。⟦像對講機的通話被建築物規則切斷後，舊作法會不斷重撥同一通；現在不再陷入反覆接通又斷線。⟧ 因此，面對會終止長持連線的伺服器，連線不會無止盡重啟。
body.en: With a serverless host that ends long-held streams at a fixed timeout, an MCP v2 connection could keep reopening its `subscriptions/listen` stream. MCP is the protocol that connects AI to outside tools, and this stream receives subscription information. ⟦It is like an intercom call cut off by building rules, where the old behavior kept redialing the same call; it no longer cycles through reconnecting and dropping.⟧ Such servers no longer trigger endless stream reopening.

items.original: Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)

title.zh-TW: 桌面版與 VS Code 的權限提示會觸發通知掛鉤
title.en: Permission prompts trigger notification hooks in Desktop and VS Code

body.zh-TW: 你在 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 裡等權限提示，若設了 Notification hook，先前它可能沒有反應。Notification hook（通知掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）原本應在需要權限時告訴你。⟦像門鈴已接好線，訪客按了卻不響；現在有人要求進門時，鈴聲會跟著響起。⟧ 這項修正只針對兩個指定環境中的權限提示，讓掛鉤能正常觸發。
body.en: If you use a Notification hook while working in Claude Desktop or VS Code, it may previously have stayed silent for a permission prompt. A Notification hook is a small program triggered by an event and should notify you when permission is needed. ⟦It is like a wired doorbell that did not ring when a visitor pressed it; now the bell sounds when someone asks to enter.⟧ The fix covers permission prompts in those two environments.

items.original: Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code

title.zh-TW: Linux 閒置沙盒不再佔滿單一 CPU 核心
title.en: Idle Linux sandbox stops filling one CPU core

body.zh-TW: Linux 上開著沙盒卻沒有操作時，先前有些閒置工作階段仍會讓一個 CPU 核心維持 100% 使用率。沙盒（sandbox，隔開程式可碰範圍的受限環境）本應在你沒動作時安靜待著，而非持續消耗處理器。⟦像空無一人的房間裡，風扇卻一直全速轉；現在沒人使用時，不會白白耗住那一台風扇。⟧ 修正後，啟用沙盒的閒置工作階段不再出現這個單核心滿載問題。
body.en: On Linux, an idle session could keep one CPU core at 100% even when sandboxing was enabled. A sandbox is a restricted environment that limits what a program can touch, and it should sit quietly when unused. ⟦It is like a fan running at full speed in an empty room; when no one is using the room, it no longer consumes that fan for nothing.⟧ Idle sandboxed sessions no longer hit that single-core saturation.

items.original: Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled

title.zh-TW: 同名技能遮住內建指令時，別名仍可使用
title.en: Bundled aliases still work when same-named skills shadow them

body.zh-TW: 你在 `-p` 模式執行，或載入 plugins、MCP 後輸入 `/checkup`、`/review`，若使用者或專案技能恰好同名，先前可能看到「Unknown command」。技能（skill，教 Claude 完成特定工作的說明組）名稱相撞時，不該讓內建別名失效。⟦像社區裡新開一家同名店，舊店的招牌卻被整塊蓋住；現在兩個既有別名仍找得到入口。⟧ 這次修正涵蓋 `-p`，以及 plugins 或 MCP 已載入的情況。
body.en: In `-p` mode, or after loading plugins or MCP, entering `/checkup` or `/review` could produce “Unknown command” if a user or project skill had the same name. A skill is a set of instructions that teaches Claude a particular job, and a name collision should not hide bundled aliases. ⟦It is like a new shop with the same name covering an older shop's whole sign; now both bundled aliases still have a visible entrance.⟧ The fix covers `-p` and the loaded plugin or MCP cases.

items.original: Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill

title.zh-TW: 指令參數不會再被當成模板標記重算
title.en: Command arguments no longer get re-read as template markers

body.zh-TW: 技能或指令收到參數後，先前參數內容可能再被展開成 template markers（模板標記，會被程式替換的特殊符號）。這會把原本只是輸入值的文字，再當成另一輪要處理的指示，改變原有輸入的意思。⟦好比表單收件員已把你寫的姓名放進欄位，卻又把姓名當成填表規則重新解讀。⟧ 現在參數代入一次後便保留其值，不會被再次展開成模板標記。
body.en: After a skill or command received an argument, its value could be expanded again as template markers: special symbols the program replaces. That treated input text as another instruction to process. ⟦It is like a form clerk placing your written name in a field, then reading the name again as instructions for filling out the form.⟧ Now an argument keeps its value after substitution instead of becoming template markers again.

items.original: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers

title.zh-TW: Windows 特殊路徑不能繞過網路路徑檢查
title.en: Windows device paths cannot bypass network-path checks

body.zh-TW: Windows 路徑若用 NT 的 `\??\` device prefix 拼寫，先前可能繞過 UNC 路徑驗證，留下 NTLM 憑證外洩風險。UNC 路徑驗證（檢查網路共享位置寫法的安全檢查）原本就該攔住這類路徑。⟦像大樓正門的證件檢查做得完整，卻有一扇寫法不同的側門沒被納入；現在側門也進了同一道檢查。⟧ 這項修正關閉的是透過該特殊前綴造成的 NTLM credential-leak 漏洞。
body.en: On Windows, a path spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix could bypass UNC path validation and expose an NTLM credential-leak vector. UNC validation is the safety check for network-share path spelling and should catch such paths. ⟦It is like a building's main entrance checking badges while a side door written differently was left outside the same check; now that side door is checked too.⟧ The fix closes the leak route created through that special prefix.

items.original: Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器啟動時不再改寫工作樹
title.en: Self-hosted runner starts without rewriting worktree

body.zh-TW: 啟動 `claude self-hosted-runner` 時，現在會先建立工作階段分支，且不必改寫工作樹。工作階段（session，一次持續工作的連線與狀態）一開始少了會擋住 agent 啟動的兩次伺服器往返。⟦像劇團開演前先在後台把分場表放好，不必把整個舞台重新布置完才准演員上場。⟧ 因此，這個 runner 的工作階段啟動時間獲得改善，agent 不再被那兩次往返阻住。
body.en: When starting `claude self-hosted-runner`, the session branch is now created without rewriting the worktree. A session is the connection and state for one continuous stretch of work, and its start no longer waits for two server round trips that blocked the agent launch. ⟦It is like placing the scene list backstage before a play, rather than rebuilding the whole stage before actors may enter.⟧ The runner's session starts faster because those two round trips no longer block the agent.

items.original: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch

title.zh-TW: 閘道轉送上游錯誤原文，方便看懂問題
title.en: Gateway forwards upstream error message itself

body.zh-TW: apps gateway 接到 Vertex、Foundry 或 AWS 上 Claude Platform 回傳的 400 或 413 錯誤時，現在會帶出上游服務自己的錯誤訊息。上游（upstream，請求原本要送往的服務端）說明能讓你看到它實際拒絕的理由。⟦像客服把倉庫退貨單的原話交給你，而非只說「出問題了」，你才知道該改哪一項。⟧
body.en: When an apps gateway receives a 400 or 413 error from Vertex, Foundry, or Claude Platform on AWS, it now carries the upstream service's own message. An upstream is the service the request was meant to reach, so its message tells you why it rejected the request. ⟦It is like support handing you the warehouse's exact return slip instead of saying only “there is a problem,” so you know what to change.⟧

items.original: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway

title.zh-TW: apps gateway 的自動壓縮錯誤已修正
title.en: Apps gateway auto-compact bug is fixed

body.zh-TW: 使用 apps gateway 的 auto-compact 時，這項錯誤已修正。auto-compact（自動壓縮，將較早對話整理得更短以騰出內容空間）是 gateway 替工作階段整理內容的流程。⟦像整理員把塞滿的資料夾換成精簡摘要，原本卡住的整理步驟現在能完成。⟧ 因此，透過 apps gateway 進行自動壓縮時，不再受這項錯誤影響。
body.en: A bug in auto-compact on apps gateway is fixed. Auto-compact condenses earlier conversation to make room for more content in a session. ⟦It is like an organizer replacing an overstuffed folder with a shorter summary, so the filing step that was stuck can now finish.⟧ Auto-compact through apps gateway is no longer affected by this bug.

items.original: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證可找出技能說明檔格式錯誤
title.en: Plugin validation finds malformed skill description files

body.zh-TW: 準備檢查 plugin 時，`claude plugin validate` 現在會查看單獨存在的 `.claude/skills` 資料夾。它會回報其中 frontmatter（檔案開頭給工具讀取的欄位）無法解析的 SKILL.md。⟦像出版前先翻開資料夾裡每本說明書的扉頁，哪本的基本資料讀不出來，便直接標給你。⟧ 即使 `.claude/skills` 是裸資料夾而非完整結構，驗證也會納入檢查。
body.en: When checking a plugin, `claude plugin validate` now examines a bare `.claude/skills` directory. It reports SKILL.md files whose frontmatter, the fields at a file's beginning for tools to read, cannot be parsed. ⟦It is like opening the title page of every manual in a folder before publication and marking any whose basic details cannot be read.⟧ Validation includes `.claude/skills` even when it stands alone rather than inside a full structure.

items.original: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器可用數字選擇努力程度
title.en: Screen readers can choose effort with numbers

body.zh-TW: 使用螢幕閱讀器調整 `/effort` 時，選擇器現在會呈現成編號清單，並要求輸入對應數字。螢幕閱讀器（screen reader，把畫面內容讀出聲的輔助工具）需要能循序讀懂每個操作選項與目前選擇。⟦像語音點餐不必在看不見的按鈕間猜位置，只要聽完菜單後說出菜號。⟧ 此外，提示文字和對話框文字不再被裁切，讀到的內容能完整保留。
body.en: When using a screen reader to change `/effort`, the selector now appears as a numbered list and asks for a typed number. A screen reader is an assistive tool that reads screen content aloud and needs an ordered way to convey choices. ⟦It is like ordering by voice without guessing among unseen buttons: hear the menu, then say the dish number.⟧ Hint text and dialog text are no longer clipped either.

items.original: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

title.zh-TW: 列印模式會提示未認得的模型 ID
title.en: Print mode flags unrecognized model IDs

body.zh-TW: 用 print mode 送出 Claude Code 不認得的 model ID 時，現在 stderr（標準錯誤輸出，程式用來報告問題的文字通道）會寫出 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`。這條診斷訊息告訴你請求確實帶了未識別的模型 ID。⟦像寄件櫃檯在收據蓋上「地址查無」章，而非讓包裹悄悄進入未知路線。⟧ 若想不再看到它，可用 `modelOverrides` 將該模型 ID 對應到已知模型。
body.en: If print mode sends a model ID Claude Code does not recognize, stderr, the program's text channel for reporting problems, now writes `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`. The diagnostic line tells you the request went out with an unknown model ID. ⟦It is like a mailing counter stamping “address not found” on the receipt instead of quietly sending a parcel onto an unknown route.⟧ Map that ID with `modelOverrides` to silence the line.

items.original: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence

title.zh-TW: 非 GitHub 儲存庫不再收到錯誤的 App 設定提醒
title.en: Non-GitHub repositories stop getting wrong app setup tip

body.zh-TW: 你的儲存庫 origin remote 在 gitlab.com 或 bitbucket.org 時，GitHub app 設定提示不再冒出來。origin remote（儲存庫連向遠端來源的位置）既不是 GitHub，就不該叫你設定 GitHub app。⟦像火車站不會把前往另一座城市的旅客帶到錯誤月台；現在目的地不是 GitHub，便不發那張車票。⟧ 同時，enterprise marketplace 提示會涵蓋不是 GitHub 的內部 Git 主機。
body.en: If a repository's origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org, the GitHub app setup tip no longer appears. An origin remote is the repository's destination for its remote source, so a non-GitHub destination should not ask for GitHub app setup. ⟦It is like a station not sending travellers for another city to the wrong platform; when the destination is not GitHub, it does not issue that ticket.⟧ The enterprise marketplace tip now covers internal Git hosts that are not GitHub.

items.original: Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts

title.zh-TW: 較新模型預設不用待辦工具，仍可用環境變數取回
title.en: Newer models hide todo tools by default, with an opt-in return

body.zh-TW: 使用 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Fable 5、Mythos 5 或更高版本模型時，TaskCreate、TaskGet、TaskUpdate、TaskList、TodoWrite 這些待辦與任務追蹤工具不再提供。這是既有工具可用範圍的變更，不是新增工具。⟦像工具箱換了新版內裝，這批型號先把待辦抽屜收起；需要的人仍可把抽屜裝回。⟧ 要恢復它們，設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`。
body.en: On Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models, the task-tracking tools TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, TaskList, and TodoWrite are no longer available. This changes the availability of existing tools; it does not add a new tool. ⟦It is like a new layout for a toolbox that stores the todo drawer away for these models, while people who need it can still put the drawer back.⟧ Set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to restore them.

items.original: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back

title.zh-TW: Windows Bash 權限調整收回過寬規則
title.en: Windows Bash permission change narrows back overly broad rules

body.zh-TW: Windows 的 auto mode 對一般 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 指令反覆停下要求手動核准，這個 2.1.232 回歸問題已修正。同時，2.1.232 對 Cygwin 風格符號連結與輸入重新導向 `< file` 的 Bash 權限改動被撤回。⟦像門禁先把普通的進出與兩種指定通道都攔下；現在普通路線恢復通行，而過寬的兩條規則先收回，等待較精準版本。⟧ 較窄的版本會在後續版本回來。
body.en: On Windows, auto mode repeatedly stopped for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands; that 2.1.232 regression is fixed. At the same time, 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks and input redirection `< file` have been reverted. ⟦It is like access control stopping ordinary passage and two named lanes; ordinary travel resumes, while the two overbroad rules are withdrawn until a narrower version returns.⟧ A narrower version will arrive in a later release.

items.original:
Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release

entries: Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default
Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly
`SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first
Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you
Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse)

Added secret redaction for GitLab token families (`glrt-`, `gloas-`, `glptt-`, `glagent-`, `glimt-`, `glsoat-`, `glcbt-`, `glft-`, `glffct-`) and full redaction of routable `glpat-`/`gldt-` tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`
Added GitLab support to plugin marketplaces: bare `gitlab.com` repo URLs (including nested subgroups) now clone like `github.com` URLs, and clone auth-failure hints name your actual git host
Settings: `additionalMarketplaces` and `allowedMarketplaces` are now accepted as friendlier aliases for `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces`
Enterprise policy: a url-typed `blockedMarketplaces` entry for a bare repo URL keeps blocking that URL when the CLI classifies it as a git clone
Gateway: the `desktop:` overlay now accepts every released Desktop setting (was 11 hand-listed keys), validated at boot against Desktop's own schema; unknown or invalid keys fail boot

Gateway: empty `managed.policies[].match.groups`/`admin.admin_groups` entries and malformed `email_domain` values (empty, or containing `@`, whitespace, or commas) now fail at boot instead of silently matching no one or granting admin access
Fable 5 is offered as an advisor in `/advisor` again for organizations with Fable access, with usage-credits consent set up through `/model fable`
Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass where variable-writing parameters could silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands' file access
Fixed a Windows permission bypass where Git Bash followed Cygwin-style symlinks that path validation saw as regular files; writes through them now require permission approval
Fixed nested git repositories inheriting trust from a parent directory; each repository now requires its own trust confirmation
Fixed MCP connections hanging for the full 30-second connect timeout when a server fails to answer or sends a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe
Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials
Fixed Remote Control sessions started from Claude Desktop or an IDE appearing as a new claude.ai session each time the local session was resumed; they now reattach to the existing one
Fixed Remote Control sessions appearing unreachable to newly attached clients while idle
Fixed Remote Control bridge sessions not restoring conversation history when the session worker restarts
Remote Control: resuming a conversation whose session was deleted from claude.ai or the app now starts a replacement instead of failing with a message about your login (regressed in v2.1.227)
Fixed Cloud gateway `/login` exiting silently or leaving an unresponsive terminal after "Press Enter to continue" when managed settings failed to load; the reason is now shown
Fixed voice mode on native builds getting stuck on "listening…" when the voice service rejected the connection; the rejection is now shown immediately
Fixed mTLS client certificate rotation requiring a restart; Claude Code now reloads the rotated cert and key automatically on connection errors
